# Shopify Briefing: Changes in the 30 Days Before 17 November 2026

**Prepared for:** Meeting with Shopify, 17 November 2026
**Review window:** 18 October to 17 November 2026
**Evidence standard:** Each fact is cited. Items I could not verify are listed in the final section.

## Executive Summary

Shopify's changes in the review window fall into three groups. The largest is the **Fall '26 Edition ("Exponential")**, which pushes Shopify's catalog, cart, and checkout into AI agents and third-party apps. The second is **merchant-facing tooling** for the Black Friday/Cyber Monday (BFCM) season, centred on Rollouts scheduling. The third is **tighter developer security**, with IP allowlist requirements phasing in through January 2027. I found no verified executive hire, no verified acquisition, and no verified partnership announced by Shopify inside the window. The meeting should focus on the agentic-commerce strategy and its implications for merchant control, because that is where the material change is.

## What Changed

### Product Launches and Platform Updates

#### Fall '26 Edition: Agentic Commerce

Shopify published the Fall '26 Edition on 28 October 2026. The developer announcement says the release "opens Shopify's catalog, cart, and checkout to any agent or app" ([Shopify, 2026](https://www.shopify.com/news/fall-26-edition-developer)). The centrepiece is **shop.dev**, a single connection that gives agents access to Shopify Catalog, Shop sign-in, cart, checkout, and Shop Pay, with no key required ([Coalition Technologies, 2026](https://coalitiontechnologies.com/blog/shopify-editions-fall-26)). **shop.md** is a skill file that lets agents such as ChatGPT and Claude discover products and check out with Shop Pay ([no7software, 2026](https://no7software.co.uk/blog/shopify-editions-fall-2026)).

Coalition reports that the Edition contains more than 150 updates and that Shopify Editions are described by Shopify as "150+ updates" ([Coalition Technologies, 2026](https://coalitiontechnologies.com/blog/shopify-editions-fall-26); [no7software, 2026](https://no7software.co.uk/blog/shopify-editions-fall-2026)). Other items reported in the same sources include:

| Item | Reported status | Source |
|---|---|---|
| WebMCP tools on every Liquid and Hydrogen storefront | Shipped (per Coalition) | [Coalition Technologies, 2026](https://coalitiontechnologies.com/blog/shopify-editions-fall-26) |
| Merchant knowledge base for store facts (e.g., return windows) that agents can repeat | Shipped (per Coalition) | [Coalition Technologies, 2026](https://coalitiontechnologies.com/blog/shopify-editions-fall-26) |
| Rebuilt Sidekick that writes code and applies multi-step changes | Shipped (per Coalition) | [Coalition Technologies, 2026](https://coalitiontechnologies.com/blog/shopify-editions-fall-26) |
| Catalog API product search across non-Shopify businesses | Beta | [Coalition Technologies, 2026](https://coalitiontechnologies.com/blog/shopify-editions-fall-26) |
| Developer commission (set by merchant in Shop Campaigns) plus 0.3% from Shopify | Early access | [Coalition Technologies, 2026](https://coalitiontechnologies.com/blog/shopify-editions-fall-26) |
| Canvas design surface | Early access (per Coalition and Meetanshi) | [Coalition Technologies, 2026](https://coalitiontechnologies.com/blog/shopify-editions-fall-26); [Meetanshi, 2026](https://meetanshi.com/blog/shopify-fall-edition-2026) |

Meetanshi notes that availability "varies by feature, region, and rollout stage" ([Gohil, 2026](https://meetanshi.com/blog/shopify-fall-edition-2026)).

#### Rollouts: Catalog Scheduling and Discounts

On 23 October 2026, Shopify expanded Rollouts to support full-catalog scheduling. Brands can schedule when catalogs go live, switch between them at set times, and bundle pricing changes with theme and checkout updates ([Common Thread Collective, 2026](https://commonthreadco.com/blogs/coachs-corner/every-shopify-update-in-2026-updated-weekly)). This update is the most directly relevant to BFCM planning. Common Thread Collective advises brands to schedule the 27 November activation now ([Common Thread Collective, 2026](https://commonthreadco.com/blogs/coachs-corner/every-shopify-update-in-2026-updated-weekly)).

#### Customer Accounts and Personalisation

Shopify added store credit balances to customer account headers and personalised product recommendations for signed-in customers who have not yet ordered. The update is dated 11 November 2026 and was first seen by Releasebot on 13 November ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/shopify)).

### Developer and Security Changes

- **IP allowlists for custom apps.** Shopify Developers requires IP allowlists for custom apps installed outside their owning organisation. Requirements phase in for new and existing installs from November 2026 through January 2027 ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/shopify)).
- **Allowlist expansion and tighter enforcement.** On 14 November 2026, Shopify Developers said apps can now combine IP addresses, CIDR ranges, and hosting-provider ASNs in allowlists while tightening security requirements for public and partner-created apps ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/shopify)).

### Context Just Outside the Window

These items fall before 18 October but shape the current environment:

- **Canvas** launched on 1 October 2026 as an AI site builder ([Common Thread Collective, 2026](https://commonthreadco.com/blogs/coachs-corner/shopify-canvas-ai-site-builder-ecommerce-q4-2026)). This conflicts with the later "early access" label (see Section 4).
- **Rollouts discounts and experiment mode** were added on 2 October. Experiment mode, which splits traffic 50/50, is available on the Grow plan and above ([Common Thread Collective, 2026](https://commonthreadco.com/blogs/coachs-corner/every-shopify-update-in-2026-updated-weekly)).
- **Script tag deprecation** begins 1 October 2026, with a second phase on 1 March 2027 ([Common Thread Collective, 2026](https://commonthreadco.com/blogs/coachs-corner/every-shopify-update-in-2026-updated-weekly)).
- **Inventory reports** switch from available quantity to on-hand quantity on 1 September 2026. Sell-through and days-of-inventory metrics will show a visible break in the data ([Huptech Web, 2026](https://www.huptechweb.com/blogs/shopify-changelog-guide)).

### Executive and Key Hires

I found **no verified Shopify executive or key hire announced in the window.** Shopify's press listing shows Jeanne DeWitt Grosser joining the board on 16 June 2026, which is outside the window ([Shopify, 2026](https://www.shopify.com/news/search)). Vanessa Lee, identified as Shopify's VP of Product, is quoted in the developer announcement, but no appointment is reported in the sources ([Shopify, 2026](https://www.shopify.com/news/fall-26-edition-developer)).

### Partnerships and Deals

- **Agent platforms.** Coalition reports that Shop Pay checkout is available inside personal AI agents, naming Meta's Muse and Claude Duet ([Coalition Technologies, 2026](https://coalitiontechnologies.com/blog/shopify-editions-fall-26)). I could not confirm this against a Shopify primary source in the material provided, so it is treated as a third-party claim.
- **Acquisitions.** The Tracxn register lists Tailwind CSS as acquired on 9 September 2026, which is before the window. Its price field is masked, and the record contains formatting errors ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-shopify/__NNWgXlWtRBr7FVe-BI1BiwMHs246IPF8HlqlcE5kZno)). No acquisition in the window is verified.
- **Earnings.** Shopify's press listing includes "Shopify to Announce Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Results." The date and content could not be verified, so I do not treat results as a window event ([Shopify, 2026](https://www.shopify.com/news/shopify-acquires-select-start-studios)).

### Market Context

Yahoo Finance shows Shopify (SHOP) at 147.09 USD at the close on 13 November, down 1.00% after hours at 145.62 USD ([Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/SHOP/press-releases)). The page does not state the year explicitly, so the date is assumed. This is a single data point, not a trend.

## Analysis

**Opinion 1: Agentic commerce is the defining move, and it shifts value away from the storefront.** Coalition argues that three releases have moved answers, discovery, and checkout off the storefront, and that whoever owns the "rails" captures the value that websites used to hold ([Coalition Technologies, 2026](https://coalitiontechnologies.com/blog/shopify-editions-fall-26)). The developer announcement frames the same change as a platform opening itself to every agent ([Shopify, 2026](https://www.shopify.com/news/fall-26-edition-developer)). My view is that the sources support the direction of this change, but the business consequences are not yet measured. The most important unknown is whether merchants keep customer-relationship data and attribution when checkout happens inside a third-party agent.

**Opinion 2: The 0.3% fee on agent-driven sales needs clearer terms before merchants commit.** The developer commission is set by the merchant, but Shopify adds a further 0.3% for sales routed through developer tools, in early access ([Coalition Technologies, 2026](https://coalitiontechnologies.com/blog/shopify-editions-fall-26)). Merchants cannot assess the cost of agent channels until they know how that fee applies across channels.

**Opinion 3: Merchant-facing changes are incremental, while platform changes are large.** The customer-account update and store-credit display are narrow changes ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/shopify)). By contrast, the Fall Edition opens the catalog and checkout broadly. For merchants, the immediate operational priority is Rollouts scheduling for BFCM, not the agent rails.

**Opinion 4: Security tightening creates near-term operational risk for agencies and custom apps.** The IP allowlist phase-in runs from November 2026 to January 2027 and overlaps with peak season ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/shopify)). Any custom app installed outside its owning organisation could break during BFCM if allowlists are not set in advance.

## Source Discrepancies and Unverified Items

| Item | Issue | Action |
|---|---|---|
| Canvas availability | Common Thread Collective says generally available on 1 October ([Common Thread Collective, 2026](https://commonthreadco.com/blogs/coachs-corner/shopify-canvas-ai-site-builder-ecommerce-q4-2026)). Coalition and Meetanshi say early access ([Coalition Technologies, 2026](https://coalitiontechnologies.com/blog/shopify-editions-fall-26); [Meetanshi, 2026](https://meetanshi.com/blog/shopify-fall-edition-2026)). | Confirm status with Shopify. |
| Shop Pay in Meta and Anthropic agents | Single third-party source. | Confirm partner status. |
| Executive and key hires | None verified in the window. | Ask whether any were made. |
| Acquisitions in window | None verified. Tailwind CSS (September) is outside the window and has incomplete data. | Treat as unverified. |
| Q3 2026 results | Date and figures not verified. | Do not cite as a window event. |
| App activity view and SimGym features | Mastroke article is undated ([Mastroke, n.d.](https://blog.mastroke.com/news/latest-shopify-updates-2026)). | Excluded from the timeline. |
| Rocket Talent pages | Third-party recruiting marketing with no Shopify personnel news ([Rocket Talent, 2026](https://rockettalent.co/blog/growth-recruiters-for-shopify-brands-complete-guide)). | Excluded. |

Several sources are secondary, including trackers, agency blogs, and aggregators. Shopify's own pages (the developer announcement and the press listing) were used where available. Dates from Releasebot reflect when items were first seen and may differ from Shopify's publication dates.

1. **What is the actual availability of Canvas and the Sidekick rebuild, by plan and region?** Sources disagree on whether Canvas is generally available or in early access, and merchants need this before planning storefront work.

2. **How does the 0.3% Shopify fee on developer-driven sales apply to agent channels such as shop.dev, and how will merchants keep customer data and attribution when checkout happens inside third-party agents?**

3. **What support will Shopify provide to agencies and custom-app owners whose apps are installed outside their owning organisation, given that IP allowlist enforcement runs from November 2026 to January 2027, during peak BFCM trading?**

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Shopify, 17 November 2026

**Window covered:** roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026. Sources are the search results provided; nothing else was used.

## Financial performance
- Shopify reported Q3 2026 results (quarter ended 30 September 2026) with 32% revenue growth (32% in constant currency) and a 22% free cash flow margin (https://www.shopify.com/news/shopify-q3-2026-financial-results). The same figures appear in the investor press release (https://www.shopify.com/investors/press-releases/shopify-sustains-rapid-growth-revenue-32-and-free-cash-flow).

## Product launches
- The Fall '26 Edition opens Shopify's catalog, cart, and checkout to any agent or app, and adds new tools for building and securing apps and storefronts (https://www.shopify.com/news/fall-26-edition-developer, 28 Oct 2026).
- Shopify's merchant-facing Fall '26 coverage is at https://www.shopify.com/news/fall-26-edition-merchant (28 Oct 2026).

## Platform changes and deadlines
- Shopify's changelog lists the IP allowlist as required for every public app by 20 November 2026, or by 12 November for apps using bulk operations. It is marked as an action-required breaking change, and ASN support now covers serverless hosting (https://shopify.dev/changelog, 5 Nov 2026).

## Customer evidence
- Shopify published Plus case studies on 24 October 2026. Dermalogica reported a 9% increase in store conversion after its September 2025 Horizon theme launch. Staples Canada ran more than four times as many website promotions during Black Friday and Cyber Monday after moving to Shopify Plus (https://www.shopify.com/enterprise/blog/brands-using-shopify-plus). These are older results shared in a recent post, not new deals.

## Offers
- A third-party page advertises three months of Shopify for $1/month, valid until 30 November 2026 (https://www.demandsage.com/shopify-free-trial). I could not confirm this offer on a Shopify page, so treat it as unverified.

## Headcount (undated)
- A company profile lists 30,025 employees, up 5,330 (21.6%) over the year and up 170 in the latest month (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/yIg9BumgrtmF). The profile is undated, so I cannot place this figure within the 30-day window.

## Hires and deals
- I found no sources for new executive hires or new partnership or acquisition deals in the window.

## Open questions
1. Which of our apps are affected by the IP allowlist requirement, and can we meet the 12 November (bulk ops) or 20 November deadline, given that the meeting falls between them?
2. With catalog, cart, and checkout now open to agents and apps, what access controls and data-security safeguards does Shopify provide, and how should we plan our integrations?
3. Is the $1/month three-month offer an official Shopify program, and if so, what terms apply after it expires on 30 November?

runs.briefing:
# Databricks Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

*Prepared 15 November 2026 for a meeting on 17 November 2026. Coverage window: approximately 16 October to 15 November 2026.*

## Executive Summary

Databricks' most significant change in the last 30 days is the launch of a second-generation Genie, which Databricks describes as an always-on autonomous enterprise agent ([Databricks, 2026, November 11](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)). Through November, Databricks also expanded Genie One into third-party assistants and shipped a steady stream of governance and cost-control features ([Microsoft, 2026, November 13](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)). Most of this activity is in Beta or Public Preview.

I could not verify any executive hire, funding event, or acquisition announced within the window. The most recent verified deal, the Row Zero acquisition, falls just outside it ([Databricks, 2026, September 24](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-acquires-row-zero-bringing-live-governed-spreadsheets)). The meeting should therefore be framed around product direction and commercial terms rather than recent corporate transactions.

## Source Reliability and Scope

Sources were weighted by provenance. Primary Databricks and Microsoft documentation were treated as authoritative. Third-party commentary was used only for context or flagged where it could not be verified.

| Source | Type | Date | Reliability Assessment |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Databricks press release](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex) | Primary (vendor) | 2026-11-11 | High for announced scope; vendor framing |
| [Azure Databricks release notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november) | Primary (platform documentation) | Updated 2026-11-13 | High; releases are staged and may reach accounts a week or more later |
| [Fundz product launch page](https://app.fundz.net/products/databricks-product-launch-917146) | Sales-intelligence vendor | 2026-11-11 | Low to moderate; used only to corroborate the launch date |
| [Flexera recap](https://www.flexera.com/blog/perspectives/databricks-data-ai-summit-2026) | Industry blog | 2026-06-30 | Moderate; background only; internally inconsistent on keynote length |
| [Atlan recap](https://atlan.com/know/ai-agent/databricks/databricks-data-ai-summit-2026-announcements) | Competitor-adjacent vendor | Undated | Low to moderate; Atlan sells a context layer and has a commercial interest in the "context" theme |
| [Databricks Agent Bricks blog](https://www.databricks.com/blog/agent-bricks-dais-2026) | Primary (vendor) | 2026 (DAIS) | High for stated metrics; vendor-reported |
| [LinkedIn post by J. Saltzman](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/jason-salt_how-databricks-will-deploy-48b-in-2026-activity-7406815692102021120-ikZi) | Individual commentary | Approximately 11 months old | Low; speculative, and not used for facts |

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### Product Launches

The second-generation Genie is the headline launch. Databricks describes it as "an always-on enterprise agent that works autonomously, manages long-running work, and proactively brings decisions to people through a new priority inbox and email" ([Databricks, 2026, November 11](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)). The same announcement reports three further points:

- **Genie Ontology** is positioned as an agentic ontology that "automatically maintains understanding of how a company operates across its data, people, and processes" ([Databricks, 2026, November 11](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)).
- **Genie Search** expands to more than 100 enterprise data sources, including the lakehouse, Google Drive, Jira, and Confluence ([Databricks, 2026, November 11](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)).
- The launch date is corroborated by a third-party tracker, which describes it as the launch of "the second-generation Genie, an always-on autonomous AI assistant for enterprise work" ([Fundz, 2026, November 11](https://app.fundz.net/products/databricks-product-launch-917146)).

The press release does not state whether the second-generation Genie is generally available. This should be confirmed in the meeting.

### Platform Release Activity (November 2026)

Microsoft's Azure Databricks release notes document the following November changes ([Microsoft, 2026, November 13](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)):

| Date | Release | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 1 Nov | AI Functions usage (for example, `ai_parse_document`, `ai_extract`, `ai_classify`) included in Unity Gateway budgets | Released |
| 2 Nov | `ai_decide` uses a new model that is reported to answer questions 33% more accurately | Beta |
| 10 Nov | Genie One Chrome extension | Beta |
| 10 Nov | Google Gemini 4 Carbon available on Unity Gateway | Released |
| 10 Nov | Budget alerts can trigger webhooks | Beta |
| 11 Nov | Genie plugin for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat | Public Preview |
| 11 Nov | Genie connectors and plugins for ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok Bot/Cursor | Released (as described) |
| 11 Nov | Genie One desktop app for Windows | Beta |
| 11 Nov | Feature Views available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile | Released |
| 13 Nov | OneLake external location file events | Public Preview |
| 13 Nov | AI Function task support in Declarative Automation Bundles | Beta |

Two details stand out. First, Genie One is now reachable from ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Cursor, which means Databricks is distributing its context layer through competing assistants. Second, AI Function spend is now governed through budgets, which signals that AI cost control is becoming a standard enterprise requirement ([Microsoft, 2026, November 13](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).

### Hires

No executive or team hires within the window could be verified from the supplied material. A 2025-era commentary post reports job openings up 23% month over month, including regional sales roles across Europe, APAC, and LatAm ([Saltzman, 2025](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/jason-salt_how-databricks-will-deploy-48b-in-2026-activity-7406815692102021120-ikZi)). Because this post is about eleven months old and is unverified commentary, it is excluded from the findings. The Fundz page states that its tool alerts users to executive hires, but it names no specific hire in this period ([Fundz, 2026, November 11](https://app.fundz.net/products/databricks-product-launch-917146)).

### Deals and Capital

No acquisition or funding round was verified within the window. The most recent verified acquisition is Row Zero, announced 24 September 2026. Databricks said the purchase would add "a familiar spreadsheet interface" to Genie, built on Genie Ontology, Unity Catalog, and Unity Gateway ([Databricks, 2026, September 24](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-acquires-row-zero-bringing-live-governed-spreadsheets)). This is about 52 days before the briefing date and is the nearest relevant transaction.

A commentary post claims Databricks raised $4.8B and lists possible uses of capital, including M&A, international expansion, and governance partnerships ([Saltzman, 2025](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/jason-salt_how-databricks-will-deploy-48b-in-2026-activity-7406815692102021120-ikZi)). These are speculative and are not treated as facts.

## Context: Earlier 2026 Milestones

These developments fall outside the 30-day window but frame the November releases:

| Milestone | Detail | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Data + AI Summit 2026 | Held 15–18 June 2026 at Moscone Center; about 30,000 in-person attendees | [Atlan, 2026](https://atlan.com/know/ai-agent/databricks/databricks-data-ai-summit-2026-announcements); [Flexera, 2026, June 30](https://www.flexera.com/blog/perspectives/databricks-data-ai-summit-2026) |
| Core message | CEO Ali Ghodsi argued that AI "doesn't struggle with intelligence; it struggles with context" | [Flexera, 2026, June 30](https://www.flexera.com/blog/perspectives/databricks-data-ai-summit-2026) |
| Agent Bricks scale | More than 100,000 agents built since launch; over one quadrillion tokens per year processed | [Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/blog/agent-bricks-dais-2026) |
| Named customers | AstraZeneca, 7-Eleven, Fox Corporation, and Block | [Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/blog/agent-bricks-dais-2026) |
| Partner recognition | Entrada named Genie Partner of the Year for enterprise deployments; Lovelytics named Brickbuilder Partner of the Year | [Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/blog/databricks-announces-2026-global-partner-awards) |

Agent Bricks was also expanded at DAIS as a full agent platform, with agents, tools, and models added to Unity Catalog so they can be governed alongside data ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/blog/agent-bricks-dais-2026)).

## Analysis and Assessment

**The November pattern is distribution and control, not new core capability.** The Genie launch is significant, but much of the surrounding activity extends existing capabilities into more channels (Microsoft 365, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Chrome, Windows) and adds governance (budgets, webhooks, compliance defaults). My assessment is that Databricks is positioning Genie as a context layer that sits beneath other people's assistants, rather than only as a native Databricks interface. This reduces the risk that a customer's preferred assistant becomes a competitor to Databricks, and it makes Unity Catalog and Genie Ontology the shared dependency.

**Maturity risk is high.** Of the November releases listed above, most are Beta or Public Preview. Microsoft also notes that releases are staged and may reach accounts a week or more after the stated date ([Microsoft, 2026, November 13](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)). Enterprise buyers evaluating always-on agents for production work will need firm GA dates and service commitments before they commit.

**Cost governance is becoming a buyer issue.** Including AI Function spend in Unity Gateway budgets from 1 November, and routing budget events to incident and ticketing tools, suggests that customers have raised cost concerns about agent workloads ([Microsoft, 2026, November 13](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)). Databricks' competitive position will depend partly on how credible these controls are at scale.

**Competitive framing.** The "context" argument is shared by competitors. Atlan, for example, presents itself as the context layer that serves governed context back to Databricks Genie ([Atlan, 2026](https://atlan.com/know/ai-agent/databricks/databricks-data-ai-summit-2026-announcements)). This suggests that the market agrees context matters, but disagrees on which vendor should own it. Atlan's commercial interest should be considered when weighing its claims.

**Limits of this assessment.** Adoption data, customer counts for the new Genie, pricing, and GA timelines were not available in the supplied material. The conclusions above should be tested against those facts in the meeting.

## Three Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **What is the GA timeline and commercial model for the second-generation Genie, the Genie Ontology, and Genie Search across 100+ sources?** The announcement does not state GA status, and the November release notes list several components as Beta or Public Preview ([Databricks, 2026, November 11](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex); [Microsoft, 2026, November 13](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).

2. **How will Databricks govern cost and autonomy for always-on agents, and what controls are available today?** Budget alerts and AI Function budgets are in Beta or newly released, and the always-on Genie introduces long-running work that could generate unpredictable spend ([Microsoft, 2026, November 13](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).

3. **Which parts of the Genie roadmap will be delivered natively, and which through third-party assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Microsoft 365 Copilot?** Distribution through competing assistants affects data residency, identity, audit trails, and the customer's choice of front-end tooling ([Microsoft, 2026, November 13](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Databricks, 17 November 2026

**Window:** roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026. Every fact below comes from the search results provided. Where a source is an unaudited claim or only a headline, I say so.

## Revenue and valuation
- Ben Horowitz's essay of 27 October puts Databricks at more than $7B in revenue run rate, growing 80% year over year. Lakehouse is above $1.5B (growing over 100%) and Lakebase above $100M. The essay gives no further breakdown, and the figures are not audited. (https://fourweekmba.com/ai-horowitz-says-databricks-hit-7b-as-agents-outquery-people)
- The same essay says agents now send Databricks more queries than people do. (https://fourweekmba.com/ai-horowitz-says-databricks-hit-7b-as-agents-outquery-people)
- Databricks remains private, with no announced IPO date or public S-1 as of October 2026. Its most recent valuation is $190B. (https://smartasset.com/investing/databricks-ipo-date-timeline-valuation-and-investment-options)

## Launches and product
- On 11 November Databricks launched native Genie plugins for ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot, giving these agents governed access to business context in Databricks. Other compatible agents can connect through the Genie One MCP server. (https://www.unite.ai/databricks-launches-native-genie-plugins-for-four-ai-agents)
- The same week Databricks launched agentic tools, including an updated Genie assistant that runs in the background and an "Ontology" feature that scans organizational data. (https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/day-anthropic-office-push-databricks-220704968.html)
- Commvault announced Data Activate for Databricks, a planned governed-data solution. Early access is planned for December 2026 in select Azure regions, and the solution is not yet generally available. This is a partner announcement, not a Databricks launch. (https://www.tradingview.com/news/tradingview:a912a3a702a15:0-commvault-cvlt-plans-governed-data-solution-for-databricks-ai)

## Customers and partners
- On 20 October HP announced it is moving its customer data platform into Databricks, with an expected 40% reduction in costs. (https://www.hpcwire.com/bigdatawire/2026/10/20/hp-moves-customer-data-platform-into-databricks-eyes-40-lower-costs)

## Investments and deals
- A press-release listing dated 12 November carries the headline "Databricks Plans $3B Investment in Europe and the Middle East." The results contain only the headline, so no details are confirmed. (https://www.hpcwire.com/bigdatawire/2026/10/20/hp-moves-customer-data-platform-into-databricks-eyes-40-lower-costs)
- A headline in the same feed reads "Databricks to Invest More Than $500M in the Netherlands." No date is shown. (https://www.hpcwire.com/bigdatawire/2026/10/20/hp-moves-customer-data-platform-into-databricks-eyes-40-lower-costs)
- Databricks' acquisition history, from an undated company profile, lists Electric DB (August 2026) and Panther Labs (June 2026). Both fall before the 30-day window, and I found no acquisition announced within it. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/7LlnrDq1nEGX)

## Hires and leadership
- I found no sources on executive or notable hires in the window.

## Open questions
1. The $7B run rate and the Lakehouse and Lakebase figures come from an investor essay, not audited accounts. What metrics can Databricks share with us directly, and on what basis?
2. With Genie plugins now live for ChatGPT, Claude and Copilot, and agents reportedly outquerying people, how does Databricks price and govern agent access, and what does this mean for our usage and costs?
3. What is the timing and scope of the reported $3B Europe and Middle East investment, and what does it mean for our region, partner programs or local support?

# Databricks Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

## Purpose and Scope

This briefing supports a meeting with Databricks on 17 November 2026. It covers the 30-day window from 16 October to 15 November 2026. Items outside that window are labelled as background. Where the supplied material contains no in-window item for a category, this is stated rather than inferred.

## Executive Summary

- **Product cadence remains high, and most in-window releases are Beta or Public Preview.** The November 2026 release notes list more than 20 items, led by the Genie One distribution push into third-party assistants ([Microsoft Learn, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Databricks, 2026a](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **The only in-window deal identified is a roughly $3 billion investment across Europe and the Middle East, announced 11 November 2026** ([Databricks, 2026b](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)).
- **No in-window executive appointments or key hires were found in the supplied sources.**
- **My assessment:** Databricks is positioning Genie One as a governed data layer that other AI front ends (ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor) can call, while keeping control, cost and governance inside Unity Catalog. The breadth of Beta and Preview status suggests the roadmap is still moving quickly.

The supplied material does not disclose their commercial terms ([Microsoft Learn, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Databricks, 2026a](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Acquisitions:** No acquisition announced within the window was identified in the supplied sources. The most recent acquisition referenced is Row Zero, announced 24 September 2026, which is outside the window ([SaaSRise, 2026](https://www.saasrise.com/deals/databricks-buys-row-zero-and-is-scouting-for-more-startups-to-acquire-0cf62ecf-edbc-447c-934d-7ef5822b8bd5)).

### Executive and Key Hires

No in-window executive appointments or key hires were identified. The only workforce material found is a recruiter article dated March 2026. It reports fewer than 50 targeted role eliminations, no WARN notice, and more than 840 open requisitions ([KORE1, 2026](https://www.kore1.com/databricks-layoffs-2026)). That article predates the window and is a third-party recruiter view, so it should be treated as low-reliability, indicative context only.

## Background Outside the Window

These items are context only and are not counted as recent developments:

- **DAIS 2026 (15–18 June 2026, Moscone Center):** Headline launches included Genie One, LTAP, Lakehouse//RT and Unity AI Gateway. The keynote theme was that AI's main constraint is context rather than intelligence ([Marattha, 2026](https://www.flexera.com/blog/perspectives/databricks-data-ai-summit-2026)).
- **Acquisitions in 2026:** Panther (announced June 2026), Electric (11 August 2026) and Row Zero (24 September 2026) ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Databricks)).
- **Microsoft partnership:** An expanded integration was announced in July 2026 ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Databricks)).
- **Funding:** A Series L round of more than $4 billion at a $134 billion valuation was reported for December 2025 ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Databricks)).

## Analysis

**1. Genie One is becoming a distribution layer, not only an in-platform product.** Eleven of the in-window items concern Genie or its clients. Connectors now exist for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Copilot Cowork, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and Grok Bot, alongside a desktop app and a Chrome extension. The matching context-based ingress change, which allows traffic from ChatGPT and Claude, indicates that Databricks is building the controls enterprises need to permit these connections ([Databricks, 2026a](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)). This strategy reduces friction for users in other tools, but it also makes Unity Catalog governance and budget controls more central to the sale.

**2. Cost control and governance are being productised alongside AI features.** Within the window, AI Function usage was brought under Unity Gateway budgets, budget thresholds can now trigger webhooks, and per-team and per-user spend limits are described in the Genie press release ([Microsoft Learn, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Databricks, n.d.](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)). This responds to a real buyer concern about unpredictable AI spend, and it is a likely basis for commercial conversation.

**3. Operations-facing AI is expanding.** Genie ZeroOps (Beta) monitors pipelines and proposes fixes, and AI Functions are now available in declarative bundles (Beta) ([Databricks, 2026a](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)). Together these move AI from answering questions toward acting on data estates. Because both are Beta, production readiness is unproven.

**4. Investment signals a go-to-market push.** The approximately $3 billion commitment to Europe and the Middle East is the largest in-window figure and points to regional expansion for enterprise AI ([Databricks, 2026b](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)). The sources do not say how the funds are split between infrastructure, hiring and partnerships.

**5. Model lifecycle churn requires attention.** Two model retirements or deprecations fell in the window (DeepSeek V4 Flash and Zhipu GLM 5.2), while the Gemini 4 Carbon addition shows the model catalogue changing frequently ([Databricks, 2026a](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Microsoft Learn, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)). Customers using affected models need migration plans, and this is a practical support topic.

**Overall assessment:** Databricks' recent activity is product-led and integration-heavy, with governance and cost controls as the main selling points. The most significant in-window commercial signal is the regional investment, and the most significant risk is that many headline capabilities are still in Beta.

## Source Reliability Notes

- **Primary and most reliable:** Databricks AWS and Azure release notes, and the Databricks newsroom press release. The press release's date is unverified in the supplied text.
- **Summit recaps (Flexera, Atlan, Concord, Databricks Community):** These are secondary and partly promotional. Flexera is used only for event dates. Atlan is a competitor-adjacent vendor.
- **Wikipedia and SaaSRise:** Useful for chronology, but secondary.
- **KORE1 and the LinkedIn post:** Recruiter and speculative sources. The LinkedIn post's $4.8 billion deployment forecast is unverified and was not used.
- **Substack review:** Opinion from an author who did not attend, not used for factual claims.

## Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **Genie One and commercial model:** As Genie connectors expand into ChatGPT, Claude and Microsoft Copilot, how does Databricks price and meter usage that originates in third-party clients, and how are Unity Gateway budgets applied across them?
2. **Investment detail:** What is the timeline and allocation of the approximately $3 billion Europe and Middle East investment, and which in-region capabilities (data residency, partner programmes, hiring) will it fund?
3. **Path to GA for Beta features:** Which in-window Beta items, particularly Genie ZeroOps, Genie One Windows app and declarative-bundle AI Function tasks, have a committed general-availability date, and what production-readiness criteria should customers meet before adopting them?

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Databricks, 17 November 2026

**Scope:** News, launches, deals, and hires from roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026, based only on the search results provided. I found no sources on hires.

## What changed

**Financials (unaudited)**
- Databricks reportedly passed a $7B revenue run rate, growing 80% year over year. Its Lakehouse product is above $1.5B (growing over 100%), and Lakebase is above $100M. These figures come from Ben Horowitz's 27 October essay, and Databricks is private, so they are not audited (https://fourweekmba.com/ai-horowitz-says-databricks-hit-7b-as-agents-outquery-people). Horowitz also said agents now send Databricks more queries than people do (https://fourweekmba.com/ai-horowitz-says-databricks-hit-7b-as-agents-outquery-people).
- The company was most recently valued at $190B. It has no announced IPO date and no public S-1 as of October 2026 (https://smartasset.com/investing/databricks-ipo-date-timeline-valuation-and-investment-options).

**Launches**
- On 11 November, Databricks launched a set of agentic AI tools. An updated Genie assistant works in the background, proactively surfacing suggestions, and a new "Ontology" feature scans an organization's data (https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/day-anthropic-office-push-databricks-220704968.html).
- Native Genie plugins were also launched on 11 November for ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork, and Grok Bot. Other compatible agents can connect through the Genie One MCP server (https://www.unite.ai/databricks-launches-native-genie-plugins-for-four-ai-agents).

**Deals and partnerships**
- HP is moving its customer data platform into Databricks, with a stated target of 40% lower costs (https://www.hpcwire.com/bigdatawire/2026/10/20/hp-moves-customer-data-platform-into-databricks-eyes-40-lower-costs).
- Databricks plans a $3B investment in Europe and the Middle East. The only detail available is a headline in a press-release list (https://www.hpcwire.com/bigdatawire/2026/10/20/hp-moves-customer-data-platform-into-databricks-eyes-40-lower-costs).
- Commvault announced "Data Activate for Databricks," which makes governed enterprise data available for analytics and AI. Early access is planned for December 2026 in select Azure regions. This is a Commvault announcement, not a Databricks one (https://www.tradingview.com/news/tradingview:a912a3a702a15:0-commvault-cvlt-plans-governed-data-solution-for-databricks-ai).

**Hires:** No sources found.

**Other coverage:** A weekly analytics roundup mentions "updates from Databricks" but gives no detail (https://solutionsreview.com/business-intelligence/analytics-and-data-science-news-for-the-week-of-november-6-updates-from-databricks-ocient-smartsheet-more).

## Caveats
- Revenue figures are self-reported and come through a third-party essay. Treat them as unverified.
- The Commvault item is not yet generally available, and adoption is unreported.
- The company profile lists acquisitions, including Electric DB (August 2026) and Panther Labs (June 2026), but both predate the 30-day window (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/7LlnrDq1nEGX).

## Open questions
1. The $7B run rate and the claim that agents now outnumber human queries are unaudited. What definitions sit behind them, and can you share the Lakehouse and Lakebase split and the share of growth from agent-driven usage?
2. Which of the new agent capabilities (background Genie, Ontology, and the native plugins for ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, and Grok) will be generally available, and how will governed agent access be priced and controlled for enterprise customers?
3. What does the $3B Europe and Middle East investment mean for data residency and regional capacity, and when will partner integrations such as Commvault's Azure early access reach our regions?

# Canva Briefing: Changes Over the Last 30 Days (16 October to 15 November 2026)

**Prepared for:** Meeting with Canva, 17 November 2026
**Information cut-off:** 15 November 2026
**Scope:** News, launches, hiring, and deals reported in the provided sources

## Executive Summary

Canva's most significant change in the last 30 days is its restructuring. On 3 November 2026, CEO Melanie Perkins announced changes affecting 1,271 people, about 22% of the workforce, through job losses, role changes, or relocation requests ([Siliconrepublic, 2026](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/business/canva-major-job-cuts-restructuring-workforce-relocation-working-life)). Product, Growth, and Platform are being merged into one organisation ([LinkedIn News, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140)).

The restructuring follows a slowdown. Canva cut its 2026 revenue growth forecast from 30% to 20% and cited higher AI serving costs ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canva); [AI Weekly, n.d.](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/canva-cuts-revenue-growth-forecast-on-ai-cost-blowout)).

No new product launches, hires, or acquisitions dated within the window are verifiable in the provided sources. The most recent acquisitions date from April 2026 ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-canva/__LHKOZhxQIkd1nKd00xe8ZiSIZ1WlxGLsiY4nuztOWOY)).

## 1. Restructuring and Workforce Changes

### 1.1 What Was Announced

| Item | Detail | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Date of internal memo | 3 November 2026 | [Niehues Consulting, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| Employees affected | 1,271 people (about 22% of workforce) | [BBC News, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo) |
| Nature of impact | Job loss, changed roles, or relocation to centralised hubs | [BBC News, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo) |
| Organisational change | Product, Growth, and Platform merging into one organisation | [LinkedIn News, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140) |
| Sydney role | Designated "primary home" for more product teams | [BBC News, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo) |
| Office policy | Hybrid workers expected to spend two to three days in office from next year | [BBC News, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo) |

Perkins described the decision as "without doubt the hardest moment in our thirteen-year history" ([BBC News, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)). She wrote that the company had experienced "our hardest year yet" and that growth had slowed "for the first time in a decade" ([BBC News, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)).

### 1.2 Severance and Support

Reported terms include:

| Benefit | Reported Detail | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Base pay | At least six months' salary, regardless of location | [Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canva); [Amazing Workplaces, 2026](https://amazingworkplaces.co/canva-layoffs-2026) |
| Healthcare | 12 months of coverage, where available | [LinkedIn News, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140) |
| Grants | $10,000 for departing staff starting businesses or community projects | [Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canva) |
| Equity | One-year vesting cliff removed for staff who joined in the last year | [Amazing Workplaces, 2026](https://amazingworkplaces.co/canva-layoffs-2026) |
| Equipment | Employees may keep their MacBooks | [LinkedIn News, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140) |
| Alumni support | Opt-in alumni directory; Perkins offered to connect hiring managers with alumni | [LinkedIn News, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140) |

Niehues Consulting reports that the 26-week severance is more than double the tech industry average ([Niehues Consulting, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)).

### 1.3 Communication Timeline

- **3 November:** Memo sent to staff ([Niehues Consulting, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)).
- **Before 10 November:** Affected staff invited to optional one-to-one meetings and kept access to Slack and Gmail until the end of the week ([Niehues Consulting, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)).
- **10 November:** Company-wide meeting ([Niehues Consulting, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)).
- **From 11 November:** Meetings of reorganised units begin ([Niehues Consulting, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)).

Canva has not disclosed how many of the 1,271 will leave the company rather than change roles or relocate ([Niehues Consulting, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)). Wikipedia describes the 1,271 as "laid off" ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canva)), which conflicts with other sources. This distinction matters for any headcount discussion.

### 1.4 Possible Further Cuts

Capital Brief reported that Canva could announce another round of redundancies or a company-wide hiring freeze in November ([People Matters, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)). This is an unconfirmed report. Canva has not confirmed it in the provided sources.

## 2. Financial and Growth Signals

| Indicator | Reported Figure | Source |
|---|---|---|
| 2026 revenue growth forecast | Cut from 30% to 20% (August 2026) | [Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canva); [People Matters, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137) |
| Q2 revenue | $921.9 million, up 25.2% year on year, reportedly missing guidance | [AI Weekly, n.d.](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/canva-cuts-revenue-growth-forecast-on-ai-cost-blowout) |
| Monthly active users (end 2025) | More than 265 million, up 20% during the year | [People Matters, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137) |
| Paid users (end 2025) | More than 31 million | [People Matters, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137) |
| Prior-year revenue | $3.5 billion (reported) | [Niehues Consulting, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| Free cash flow | Reportedly profitable on a free cash flow basis | [Niehues Consulting, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| Valuation | Downgraded by backers Blackbird Ventures and Airtree from A$60bn to about A$49bn | [BBC News, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo) |
| AI task cost | Reportedly down nearly 90% since Canva AI 2.0 launched in April | [Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canva) |

Perkins acknowledged that the revised outlook was "below the ambitious goal we set at the beginning of the year" ([People Matters, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)). She also said Canva had slowed the AI rollout to improve unit economics and rebuild its technology architecture ([People Matters, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)). AI Weekly, citing The Information, reports that some AI features are running up to six months late and that some users have moved to ChatGPT ([AI Weekly, n.d.](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/canva-cuts-revenue-growth-forecast-on-ai-cost-blowout)).

AI Pass is reportedly priced at US$100 per user per month ([AI Weekly, n.d.](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/canva-cuts-revenue-growth-forecast-on-ai-cost-blowout)).

## 3. Product and Launches

**Within the window:** The provided sources do not confirm any product launch dated between 16 October and 15 November 2026.

**Background (outside the window):**

- **Canva AI 2.0** was introduced in April 2026 and described by Canva as "the biggest product launch in our history" ([Canva, 2026](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-create-2026-ai)).
- **May 2026 release notes** included Colour themes for brand admins, presenter-notes enhancements, a refreshed chart library, custom short links for shared designs, a Meta Catalog Data app for product videos, and TikTok ad publishing ([Canva, 2026](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/whats-new-may-2026)).
- **Newsroom listings** reference Affinity for iPad, Canva Brush (a vision-language model for design), Canva Craft, and Muse from Meta ([Canva, 2026](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/whats-new-may-2026)). The provided material does not show publication dates for these items, so they cannot be confirmed as within the 30-day window.

Canva's stated product strategy is end-to-end marketing coverage. In its Ortto and Simtheory announcement, Canva said Ortto would "power the entire marketing and content lifecycle" ([Canva, 2026](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/simtheory-ortto-join-canva)).

## 4. Hiring

**Within the window:** No new hiring announcements are verifiable in the provided sources. The only reported hiring-related signal is the possible hiring freeze described in Section 1.4 ([People Matters, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)).

Canva has also said that it expects hybrid staff to spend two to three days a week in the office from next year ([BBC News, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)). This policy will affect retention and recruitment outside Sydney.

## 5. Deals and Acquisitions

**Within the window:** No acquisitions are recorded in the provided sources for 16 October to 15 November 2026. The most recent acquisition is Ortto, completed in April 2026 ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-canva/__LHKOZhxQIkd1nKd00xe8ZiSIZ1WlxGLsiY4nuztOWOY)).

**Recent activity (2026):**

| Date | Target | Focus | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 24 February | Scene Group | Not specified in provided source | [Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-canva/__LHKOZhxQIkd1nKd00xe8ZiSIZ1WlxGLsiY4nuztOWOY) |
| 26 February | Cavalry | Not specified in provided source | [Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-canva/__LHKOZhxQIkd1nKd00xe8ZiSIZ1WlxGLsiY4nuztOWOY) |
| 25 March | Doohly | Marketing | [Canva, 2026](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/simtheory-ortto-join-canva) |
| 8 April | Simtheory | Not specified in provided source | [Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-canva/__LHKOZhxQIkd1nKd00xe8ZiSIZ1WlxGLsiY4nuztOWOY) |
| 8 April | Ortto (team of about 40) | Marketing automation and analytics | [Canva, 2026](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/simtheory-ortto-join-canva) |

Tracxn records seven acquisitions in 2026, against an average of 1.4 per year from 2020 to 2025 ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-canva/__LHKOZhxQIkd1nKd00xe8ZiSIZ1WlxGLsiY4nuztOWOY)). Acquisition prices are not disclosed in the provided sources.

The pace of acquisitions in the first half of 2026 contrasts with the cost pressures reported in the second half. This is a question for the meeting.

## 6. Source Reliability and Discrepancies

| Issue | Sources in Conflict | Assessment |
|---|---|---|
| "Laid off" vs "affected" | Wikipedia states 1,271 were laid off ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canva)); BBC, Silicon Republic, and Niehues describe a mix of role changes, relocations, and exits ([BBC News, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo); [Siliconrepublic, 2026](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/business/canva-major-job-cuts-restructuring-workforce-relocation-working-life)) | Treat the 1,271 as "affected" until Canva confirms exit numbers. |
| Valuation | BBC cites A$49bn ([BBC News, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)); Amazing Workplaces cites about $35bn ([Amazing Workplaces, 2026](https://amazingworkplaces.co/canva-layoffs-2026)) | Currency and date differences likely explain some of the gap. Use the BBC figure with the currency stated. |
| Forecast cut timing | Wikipedia and People Matters place the cut in August 2026 ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canva); [People Matters, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)) | Consistent across sources. |
| Possible second round | Capital Brief report, relayed by People Matters ([People Matters, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)) | Unconfirmed. Do not present as fact. |
| Severance details | Reported by LinkedIn, Wikipedia, and Amazing Workplaces, citing Fast Company ([LinkedIn News, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140); [Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canva); [Amazing Workplaces, 2026](https://amazingworkplaces.co/canva-layoffs-2026)) | Consistent across the reporting. Confirm with Canva before citing as official. |

Commentary on LinkedIn, including posts praising Canva's treatment of staff, reflects individual opinion and is not treated here as company disclosure ([LinkedIn News, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140)). The Niehues Consulting analysis is also interpretive. It argues the restructuring targets handover friction between teams ([Niehues Consulting, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)). Canva's own framing emphasises slowing growth and rising AI costs ([CTO Magazine, n.d.](https://ctomagazine.com/canva-layoff-2026-workforce-restructuring-what-leaders-need-to-understand)).

## 7. Analysis and Our View

**Our assessment:** The restructuring is primarily a response to unit economics and growth deceleration, not a direct substitution of people by AI. Canva has attributed the change to slowing growth and rising AI costs ([CTO Magazine, n.d.](https://ctomagazine.com/canva-layoff-2026-workforce-restructuring-what-leaders-need-to-understand); [People Matters, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)). Amazing Workplaces notes that the reporting does not say AI replaced staff ([Amazing Workplaces, 2026](https://amazingworkplaces.co/canva-layoffs-2026)).

We see three implications:

1. **Consolidation is a bet on speed.** Merging Product, Growth, and Platform may shorten the path from insight to shipped feature. This matters because AI features have reportedly slipped by up to six months ([AI Weekly, n.d.](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/canva-cuts-revenue-growth-forecast-on-ai-cost-blowout)). The reorganisation may compress that gap, but it introduces execution risk during the transition. Units only begin meeting from 11 November ([Niehues Consulting, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)).

2. **The growth gap is competitive as well as internal.** Reported Q2 growth of 25.2% is above the 20% full-year forecast ([AI Weekly, n.d.](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/canva-cuts-revenue-growth-forecast-on-ai-cost-blowout)). This implies management expects deceleration in the second half. Chris G | VC + Startups on Instagram: "Canva’s 2026 layoffs have a plot twist: the company is helping its former employees become entrepreneurs.

Imagine getting laid off and your employer offers to help fund your next startup. That’s essentially what Canva is doing.

CEO Melanie Perkins announced a restructuring affecting 1,271 employees, or 22% of the workforce. Not all are being laid off; some face role changes or relocation.

But look at the exit package:

→ At least 6 months of salary
→ 12 months of healthcare where available
→ Employees keep their MacBooks
→ $10,000 startup grants through the Canva Collective Fund, with no equity taken
→ Career coaching and LinkedIn Premium

Now here’s what investors should actually pay attention to.

Canva lowered its 2026 revenue growth forecast from 30% to 20% as AI costs put pressure on its business model.

Meanwhile, Product, Growth, and Platform are being consolidated into one organization.

Translation: AI isn’t just changing what software companies sell. It’s changing the cost of delivering their products and how teams need to operate.

And here’s the overlooked opportunity: Canva’s departing talent could become the next generation of startup founders.

Losing your job is never easy. But giving employees financial runway, healthcare, and a chance to build something new is a much better exit than simply handing them a severance check.

The lesson for founders? How you treat employees on the way out says a lot about how you build a company.

Would you rather have six months of severance or a shot at funding your own startup?

runs.briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Canva, 17 November 2026

**Scope:** Developments from the search results, dated 2 to 10 November 2026. Each fact is cited to its source.

## Summary

Canva has restructured. On 3 November it announced cuts affecting 22% of its global workforce, about 1,271 staff, as it flattens its org chart and consolidates teams. The same week it expanded its OpenAI partnership and faced reports of further cuts or a hiring freeze.

## What changed

**Restructuring and layoffs**
- Canva lays off 22% of staff, about 1,271 people, to flatten the org chart and consolidate teams (https://www.computerworld.com/article/3816579/tech-layoffs-this-year-a-timeline.html).
- CEO Melanie Perkins said "small changes won't be enough" and that Canva needs to "re-found" itself around "small, empowered teams" (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304).
- The company is merging its product, growth and platform teams and reducing "subspecialisation," so remaining staff may take on broader responsibilities (https://tech.yahoo.com/general/breaking-news/article/tech-layoffs-tracker-2026-all-the-job-losses-across-canva-squarespace-amazon-microsoft-apple-meta-and-others-141507340.html).
- Departing staff get at least six months' salary plus other support (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304). Benefits include keeping their company MacBooks, a free year of LinkedIn Premium and career coaching (https://m.economictimes.com/news/international/world-news/canva-layoffs-2026-meet-ceo-melanie-perkins-who-plans-to-give-away-80-of-her-billion-dollar-fortune-as-1271-jobs-are-cut/articleshow/135575689.cms). Those leaving can also apply for US$10,000 grants to start a business or community project (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304).
- Capital Brief reported previously unreported finance-division cuts in January, with 32 roles made redundant (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).
- Capital Brief also reported that Canva could announce another round of redundancies or a hiring freeze in November. Canva has not confirmed either (https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137).

**AI and partnerships**
- Canva expanded its OpenAI deal, gaining broader access to OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra and GPT-5.6 models. The two companies will work on making them more economical to run, though no savings or costs were disclosed. This came days after Canva launched its second in-house AI model (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).
- OpenAI already powers Canva Code, which builds interactive designs, websites and apps from text descriptions (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).

**Marketing**
- Canva unveiled a campaign by new agency GS&P, "What Will You Canva Today?", with three comedy TV spots. The first aired during NBC Sunday Night Football on 1 November. Out-of-home and social work are also part of it (https://www.mediapost.com/publications/article/419113/canva-unveils-campaign-by-new-agency-gsp.html).

**Hires and deals**
- No new hires or executive appointments were found in the results.
- The only acquisition-related data is an undated company profile listing deals from February to April 2026, including Ortto, SimTheory and Doohly (US$30M). These fall outside the 30-day window (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/wafeqPWRLzYp).

## Source gaps
- No hiring or leadership-change news was found for the period.
- The company profile is undated, so its deal list cannot be confirmed as current.

## Open questions
1. After the 3 November restructure, is a further redundancy round or hiring freeze planned for November, and which teams would it affect?
2. How will the expanded OpenAI partnership and the second in-house model change Canva's product roadmap and partner priorities, and do you expect cost savings from running the models more efficiently?
3. With product, growth and platform teams merged, who will be our day-to-day counterparts and final decision-makers, and will "re-founding" Canva change our account or partner arrangements?

# Canva: Pre-Meeting Briefing for 17 November 2026

*Prepared 15 November 2026. Review window: 16 October to 15 November 2026. Unverified items are marked **[unverified]**.*

## Executive Summary

Canva's largest change in the window is a workforce restructuring. CEO Melanie Perkins described it as "our hardest year yet," after growth slowed "for the first time in a decade" ([BBC, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)). No verified product launches, executive hires, or new deals fall inside the 30-day window in the material reviewed.

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### News: Restructuring

| Item | Detail | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Scope | 1,271 people (about 22% of staff) affected through job loss, role change, or relocation | [Silicon Republic, 2026](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/business/canva-major-job-cuts-restructuring-workforce-relocation-working-life) |
| Organisation | Product, Growth and Platform merging into one organisation | [LinkedIn, 2026](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140) |
| Location | Sydney to become the "primary home" for more product teams; hybrid staff expected in the office 2–3 days a week from next year | [BBC, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo) |
| Timeline | Memo issued 3 November; company-wide meeting 10 November; reorganised units meet from 11 November | [Niehues Consulting, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| Severance | Reported: six months' salary, 12 months' healthcare, $10,000 support, career assistance, laptop retention. One commentator's post and one practitioner article report these; the 26-week figure is from Niehues | [LinkedIn, 2026](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140); [Amazing Workplaces, 2026](https://amazingworkplaces.co/canva-layoffs-2026) |
| Exit count | Canva has not disclosed how many will leave | [Niehues Consulting, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| Further cuts | Reported possible second round or hiring freeze in November **[unverified]** | [PeopleMatters, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137) |

### Financial Context (Mostly Before the Window, Newly Reported)

- The 2026 growth forecast was cut from 30% to 20%, which The Information attributed to heavy AI use driving up costs ([The Information, 2026](https://x.com/theinformation/status/2086158004525699220)).
- Reported Q2 2026 revenue was $921.9 million, up 25.2% year over year, which missed internal guidance ([The SaaS CFO, 2026](https://www.thesaascfo.com/ai-cogs-earnings-risk)).
- Perkins reportedly wrote that Canva had been "relying too heavily on frontier models" ([The SaaS CFO, 2026](https://www.thesaascfo.com/ai-cogs-earnings-risk)).
- Valuation reportedly fell from A$60bn to about A$49bn ([BBC, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)).
- **Source conflict:** Prior-year revenue is reported as $3.5 billion ([Niehues Consulting, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)), about $3 billion GAAP ([ORM News, 2026](https://orm-tech.com/news/20260813-canva-cuts-2026-growth-forecast-by-a-third-on-ai-costs)), and about $4 billion ARR ([The SaaS CFO, 2026](https://www.thesaascfo.com/ai-cogs-earnings-risk)). Canva is private, so treat these figures as unverified.

### Product Launches

No launch dated within the window was verified. Recent items, all outside it:

| Launch | Date | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Canva Grow 2.0 (ad creation and performance loop) | 24 June 2026 | [Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/canva) |
| Magic Layers in Gemini and ChatGPT | 7 June 2026 | [Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/canva) |
| Learn Grid (free education platform) | 11 May 2026 | [Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/canva) |
| Canva AI 2.0 ("biggest product launch in our history") | Date not verified **[unverified]** | [Canva Newsroom, 2026](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-create-2026-ai) |
| Creative Operating System | Date not verified **[unverified]** | [Canva Newsroom, 2026](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/creative-operating-system) |

### Executive and Key Hires

No executive appointments or key hires were found in the material. Perkins remains CEO and is the named spokesperson for the restructuring ([BBC, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)). An opt-in alumni directory has been set up for departing staff ([LinkedIn, 2026](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140)).

### Deals and Partnerships

No deals were dated within the window. Ongoing partnerships include Canva as a design partner across Perplexity, Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot and Gemini ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/canva)), plus integrations with HubSpot, Mailchimp, Klaviyo and Meta's catalogue ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/canva)). Their exact dates are not verified.

## Analysis

In my view, the restructuring is primarily a response to growth and cost pressure, not a direct AI-substitution story. Canva's stated rationale is slowing growth and the need to move faster, and the cost pressure comes from AI inference, not from replacing staff ([Amazing Workplaces, 2026](https://amazingworkplaces.co/canva-layoffs-2026)). Merging Product, Growth and Platform targets the handoff delays that the company's own reporting implies slowed its launches ([Niehues Consulting, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)).

The main execution risk is timing. The reorganisation coincides with a major AI product push and an active cost-reduction programme, and reports of further cuts or a hiring freeze suggest the structure is not yet settled. Source quality is mixed: the BBC, Silicon Republic and The Information are the most reliable. The LinkedIn items and the SaaS CFO's secondary citations of Canva's letter should be used with caution.

## Open Questions for Canva

1. Of the 1,271 people affected, what is the split between exits, role changes and relocations, and is the reported November hiring freeze or second round of cuts planned?
2. What AI unit-cost targets has Canva set, and how do they feed into the revised 20% growth forecast?
3. How will decision rights work in the merged Product organisation, particularly for Grow 2.0 and other launches that depended on Growth-to-Product handoffs?

runs.briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Canva, 17 November 2026

**Scope:** Developments from the last 30 days, based only on the search results provided. Every fact is cited to its source URL.

## Restructuring and layoffs

- Canva announced a restructure affecting 22% of its global workforce. CEO Melanie Perkins said "small changes won't be enough" and that the company needs to "re-found Canva" around small, empowered teams (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304).
- The cuts affect 1,271 employees, over one-fifth of the workforce. The company is flattening the org chart and consolidating teams (https://www.computerworld.com/article/3816579/tech-layoffs-this-year-a-timeline.html).
- Canva is merging its product, growth and platform teams and reducing "subspecialisation," so remaining staff may take on broader responsibilities (https://tech.yahoo.com/general/breaking-news/article/tech-layoffs-tracker-2026-all-the-job-losses-across-canva-squarespace-amazon-microsoft-apple-meta-and-others-141507340.html).
- Severance includes at least six months' salary, retention of company MacBooks, a free year of LinkedIn Premium, and career coaching and healthcare support (https://m.economictimes.com/news/international/world-news/canva-layoffs-2026-meet-ceo-melanie-perkins-who-plans-to-give-away-80-of-her-billion-dollar-fortune-as-1271-jobs-are-cut/articleshow/135575689.cms; https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304). Departing staff can also apply for $US10,000 grants to start a business or pursue a community project (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304).
- Before the announcement, a Capital Brief report said Canva could cut jobs or freeze hiring in November amid a revised revenue growth outlook. Canva had not confirmed either at that time (https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137).
- Capital Brief also reported previously unreported finance-division cuts in January, with 32 roles made redundant (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).

## Launches and partnerships

- Canva expanded its OpenAI partnership, giving it broader access to OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra and GPT-5.6 models. The two companies will work on making them cheaper to run, though no savings or costs were disclosed. OpenAI already powers Canva Code (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).
- The deal came days after Canva launched its second in-house AI model (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).
- Canva unveiled a North America campaign, "What Will You Canva Today?", created by new agency GS&P. The first spot aired during NBC Sunday Night Football on 1 November (https://www.mediapost.com/publications/article/419113/canva-unveils-campaign-by-new-agency-gsp.html).

## Hires and M&A

- No hiring announcements or new executive appointments were found in the results.
- The results list acquisitions (Ortto, SimTheory, Doohly, and others), but all are dated before the 30-day window, so they are excluded here (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/wafeqPWRLzYp).

## Limitations

- Sources are mostly secondary coverage. No Canva primary statement was in the results beyond quotes reprinted in press coverage.
- The results contain no information on the scope or timing of any further November cuts or a hiring freeze beyond the pre-announcement report.

## Open questions

1. Is any further redundancy round or hiring freeze still planned after the 3 November restructure, and if so, which teams are affected?
2. What cost or performance targets are attached to the expanded OpenAI partnership, and which products will change first?
3. With product, growth and platform teams merging, who will be our primary contact and decision-maker going forward?
