# Razorpay: Pre-Meeting Briefing for 17 November 2026

*Prepared 15 November 2026. Review window: 16 October to 15 November 2026.*

## Scope and Source Approach

This briefing uses only the material provided. Razorpay's own newsroom and blog are treated as primary sources for company claims. Trade press (The Paypers, Analytics India Magazine) is used for reported events, and these are labelled as reported where the company has not confirmed them. Awwwards is used only for event framing. Built In, a employee-review aggregator, is used only for background. Items whose publication date could not be verified are marked **[Unverified date]**. Items outside the 30-day window are presented as context only.

## Summary Assessment

In my assessment, the most material verifiable event in the window is the final IFSCA licence for GIFT City, which gives Razorpay a regulated route for cross-border money movement. The most consequential reported event is a possible IPO, but it rests on press reports and has not been confirmed by the company. Product and AI announcements are numerous, but the sources provide almost no adoption or revenue data to test them. I would treat the AI-first positioning as a strategic direction rather than a proven commercial result until metrics are shared.

## 1. Material Changes in the Last 30 Days

### 1.1 Regulatory Milestone: GIFT City Licence

On 3 November 2026, Razorpay announced it had received its final IFSCA licence for GIFT City. The company says the licence brings global investing, international collections, settlements, and multi-currency capabilities under one regulated infrastructure ([Razorpay Newsroom, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/press)). Razorpay also states that integration timelines are cut from months to 2–3 weeks, and that key investment platforms will go live "soon" ([Razorpay Newsroom, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/press)). No go-live dates or partner names are given in the excerpt, so the commercial timing remains unclear.

### 1.2 Leadership and Engineering Hires

Analytics India Magazine reports that Razorpay has added four senior engineering leaders from Microsoft, Salesforce, CRED, and Divyam.AI ([Analytics India Magazine, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/analytics-india-magazine_razorpay-ai-fintech-activity-7490353347590311936-jESz)). The named hires are Sudhir Reddy (former CTO and Co-founder of Divyam.ai, leading AI and data architecture), Abhishek Agarwal (Microsoft), Bhavya S. (Salesforce), and Anuj Mathur (CRED). CTO and Co-founder Shashank Kumar said the hires support the goal of building AI-native financial infrastructure ([Analytics India Magazine, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/analytics-india-magazine_razorpay-ai-fintech-activity-7490353347590311936-jESz)). **[Unverified date]**: the post carries no visible publication date, so I cannot confirm these hires fall within the window.

### 1.3 Product Launches and Positioning

Razorpay's Sprint26 is described as the company's annual product launch, with over 100 product updates across six verticals: Agentic Stack, International Payments, Payment Gateway, D2C, Marketing, and Business Banking ([Awwwards, 2026](https://www.awwwards.com/razorpay-sprint26-the-future-of-payments.html)). The Awwwards article is dated 12 November 2026, but the event date is not stated, so **[Unverified date]** applies to the launch timing.

At FTX 2026, Razorpay reportedly launched four agentic products: Agentic Platform, Agentic Payments, Agent Studio, and Agentic Business Banking ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/razorpay_keynote-reimagining-money-movement-activity-7437771494610411520-QuVn)). The keynote post is undated in the material **[Unverified date]**. The company describes RAY, its WhatsApp-based AI account manager, as able to answer business questions and fix payment issues ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/m/gff2026)). That GFF page is tied to September events, so RAY itself predates the window.

### 1.4 Reported IPO Activity

The Paypers reports that Razorpay has reportedly received SEBI approval for an IPO ([The Paypers, n.d.](https://thepaypers.com/payments/news/razorpay-reportedly-receives-sebi-approval-for-ipo)). A separate Paypers piece reports the company is rumoured to seek a USD 500 million IPO, placing it among new-age Indian firms preparing to list over the next 12 to 18 months ([The Paypers, n.d.](https://thepaypers.com/payments/news/razorpay-reportedly-plans-usd-500-mln-ipo-amid-digital-payments-surge)). **Both items are unconfirmed reports, and the publication dates are not visible in the material.** I would not treat either as fact until Razorpay confirms.

### 1.5 Partnerships and Deals

No partnership announcement in the material is verifiably dated within the window. The OpenAI ChatGPT Ads partnership (5 October 2026) falls 41 days before the briefing date, so it is outside the window ([Razorpay Newsroom, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/press)). The Replit partnership, which makes Razorpay the India payments partner for Replit's AI platform, is listed on a page last updated 15 June 2026 ([Razorpay Newsroom, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/razorpay-becomes-the-india-payments-partner-for-replits-global-ai-platform)). **[Unverified date]** applies to the Replit item.

## 2. Context Outside the 30-Day Window

Built In states that Razorpay has a leading share of India's online payment gateway market and that FY24 core gateway revenue grew, with acceleration into FY25 ([Built In, n.d.](https://builtin.com/company/razorpay/faq/stability-growth)). These claims come from an employee-review aggregator, so I rate them as directional rather than audited. The provided material contains no current revenue, TPV, or valuation figures for 2026.

## 3. Merchant Offer Watch: 90-Day 0% Platform Fee

Razorpay's blog describes a 90-day 0% platform fee offer for new merchants, with ₹5,00,000 in Amount Credits auto-applied after activation ([Razorpay Blog, 2026](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026)). Key conditions include:

- KYC completion and activation on or after 1 July 2026 (Clause 1) ([Razorpay Blog, 2026](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026)).
- Only the first activated Merchant ID under a PAN or bank account qualifies (Clause 7) ([Razorpay Blog, 2026](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026)).
- Merchants who transacted on Razorpay before 1 July 2026 are disqualified (Clause 8) ([Razorpay Blog, 2026](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026)).
- Unused credits lapse at day 90 with no carry-forward or cash redemption (Clause 10) ([Razorpay Blog, 2026](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026)).
- Prepaid cards, corporate credit cards, AMEX, Diners Club, and all EMI-based methods are excluded (Clause 5) ([Razorpay Blog, 2026](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026)).

The blog illustrates the stakes with a merchant at about ₹1 lakh monthly GMV paying 2% plus 18% GST, roughly ₹28,320 a year ([Razorpay Blog, 2026](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026)). That figure checks out arithmetically: 2% of ₹1,00,000 is ₹2,000 a month, or ₹24,000 a year, and 18% GST on that adds ₹4,320. The blog's publication date is not visible, so **[Unverified date]** applies to the offer's current status. The blog also says the official terms govern and should be checked in the dashboard.

**My view:** the exclusions and the one-MID rule suggest the offer is aimed at acquiring net-new small merchants and steering them toward UPI, rather than broadly lowering prices for existing clients. That is a sensible acquisition lever, but it also means the offer's economic value for larger merchants is limited.

## 4. Analytical Assessment

**Strengths.** The GIFT City licence is verifiable, primary-sourced, and strategically concrete. It extends the company's cross-border proposition from a product idea to a regulated capability.

**Risks and gaps.** The agentic and AI narrative is heavily announced but thinly evidenced in the material. The sources give no adoption, success-rate, or revenue data for RAY, Vulcan, or Agent Studio. One LinkedIn repost cites success rates of up to 95% for transfers, but it comes from a third-party magazine and has no methodology, so I have not relied on it ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/razorpay_keynote-reimagining-money-movement-activity-7437771494610411520-QuVn)).

**Leadership signal.** The reported engineering hires, if confirmed within the window, point to a deliberate build-out of AI and data architecture capacity. Given that the IPO is only reported, the company's disclosure posture in the coming months will matter.

**Information quality.** Several in-window items are undated or unconfirmed. Before the meeting, the team should verify the IPO reports, the hire dates, and the Sprint26 event date against Razorpay's own channels.

## 5. Information Gaps to Resolve Before the Meeting

- Publication dates for the hires post, the FTX keynote post, the Sprint26 event, and the Replit announcement.
- Whether the SEBI approval and USD 500 million IPO size have been confirmed by Razorpay or a regulator.
- Go-live dates and partners for the GIFT City investment platforms.
- Current revenue, TPV, and valuation figures, none of which appear in the provided material.

## What Is Razorpay’s 0% Platform Fee Offer and How Does It Actually Work?

Razorpay’s 0% platform fee offer waives the platform fee charged on eligible successful domestic transactions for new merchants for their first 90 days. It is a temporary promotional waiver of Razorpay’s own technology and service fee, separate from the RBI-mandated zero MDR on BHIM-UPI and RuPay debit card transactions. Exact terms are set in the official offer conditions. [...] The Razorpay 0% platform fee offer waives Razorpay’s platform fee on eligible domestic transactions for new merchants for the first 90 days from account activation, up to a cumulative transaction value of ₹5,00,000, whichever is exhausted first. GST and a ₹199 + tax KYC processing fee are not waived. The offer is auto-applied to eligible accounts activated on or after 1 July 2026. [...] Q6: Is there any fee to pay during activation that the offer does not waive?  
 Yes. A one-time KYC processing fee of ₹199 plus applicable taxes applies at activation. GST on the platform fee is also not waived at any point during the window. The offer only waives Razorpay’s platform fee itself.

Q7: Is the standard platform fee 2% or 2.15%? Most domestic methods are priced at 2% + GST, while 2.15% applies specifically to RuPay Credit Card on UPI. Confirm the exact rate in your dashboard.

**Basis:** Search results only. No outside information added.

## Summary
Razorpay has cleared the main regulatory step for its IPO. The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) issued its final observations on the draft papers, and reporting puts the offering at roughly ₹5,000 to ₹6,000 crore. Details on price band and offer structure are still pending.

## Recent changes

**News and regulatory milestones**
- SEBI's approval for Razorpay's IPO was reported on Friday, 13 November 2026. The company had confidentially filed draft papers in June, for an IPO reportedly sized at about $600 million (Reuters via The Hindu). (https://www.thehindu.com/business/indian-fintech-firm-razorpay-gets-regulatory-nod-for-ipo/article71698143.ece)
- SEBI issued its final observations on Razorpay's draft offer documents on 3 November, clearing the way for the next listing stages (Economic Times). (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms)
- Inc42 reported the SEBI nod on 4 November under a ₹6,000 crore headline. (https://inc42.com/buzz/razorpay-gets-sebi-nod-for-%E2%82%B96000-cr-ipo)
- Shareholders approved a fresh share issue worth ₹2,700 crore, plus an offer for sale (OFS) that lets existing investors partly sell down (Economic Times). (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms)
- Axis Capital, JPMorgan, Citi and Kotak Mahindra Capital are advising on the IPO (Economic Times). (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms)
- Before approval, Upstox reported the IPO was expected to raise ₹5,000 to ₹6,000 crore, with price band and structure to follow the red herring prospectus (RHP) filing. (https://upstox.com/news/market-news/ipo/upcoming-ip-os-mahanadi-coalfields-oyo-cult-fit-carlsberg-india-are-among-big-ticket-ip-os-expected-after-jio-platforms-listing/article-202719)

**Deals and licences**
- A Business Standard page listed a headline that Razorpay received a final licence to expand cross-border payments from GIFT City. The snippet did not include the article body, so scope and timing are unconfirmed. (https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/ifsca-proposes-model-portfolios-in-gift-city-by-research-entities-126110900766_1.html)

**Headcount**
- A company profile lists 4,033 employees: down 16 (-0.4%) over the year, down 23 over the quarter, and up 2 over the month. The profile is undated. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/aJrBNen1btW7)

**Hires**
- No hiring announcements were found in the results.

## Source gaps
- Reported IPO sizes differ across sources: about $600 million (The Hindu), ₹5,000 to ₹6,000 crore (Upstox), and a ₹2,700 crore fresh issue plus OFS (Economic Times). The Hindu's report is dated 13 November, while Economic Times and Inc42 place the SEBI observations on 3 November. The IPO is not yet priced.
- The GIFT City item is a headline only.

## Open questions
1. **Timeline:** When do you expect to file the RHP and set the price band, and what is the target listing window relative to today's meeting?
2. **Offer structure:** How will the final size split between the ₹2,700 crore fresh issue and the OFS, and how should we reconcile the differing size reports?
3. **Growth plans:** Given the year-on-year headcount decline, what hiring plans do you have, and how does the GIFT City cross-border licence fit into international expansion?

# Razorpay: Meeting Briefing for 17 November 2026

**Prepared:** 15 November 2026
**Look-back window:** 16 October to 15 November 2026
**Scope:** News, launches, hires, and deals drawn only from the provided sources

---

## Purpose and Scope

This briefing supports a meeting with Razorpay on 17 November 2026. It covers the last 30 days and gives context from earlier in 2026 where it helps interpret recent moves. Each substantive claim cites its source. Where a claim comes from the company's own marketing, or where a date could not be confirmed, the briefing says so.

---

## Executive Summary

- **Only one verified development falls inside the 30-day window.** Razorpay received its final IFSCA licence for GIFT City on 3 November 2026 ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/press)).
- **No deal, acquisition, or senior hire dated inside the window appears in the sources.** The most recent leadership and AI hiring news is dated 8 August 2026 ([MitchelLake, 2026](https://mitchellake.com/intelligence/wire/razorpay-strategic-hiring-2026-08-08)).
- **The product cadence was heavy in August to early October.** Vulcan, RAY on WhatsApp, Apple Pay, and the OpenAI ChatGPT Ads partnership all fall before the window opens ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/press)).
- **Our assessment:** Razorpay is steering toward AI-native and cross-border financial infrastructure, with payments acceptance still the core. The public evidence is mostly company-issued, so independent validation is needed before relying on the strategic claims.

---

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

| Date | Category | Development | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 Nov 2026 | Regulatory / Licence | Final IFSCA licence for GIFT City, positioned to bring global investing, international collections, settlements, and multi-currency capabilities under one regulated infrastructure | [Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/press) |
| 3 Nov 2026 | Integration | Company claims integration timelines drop from months to 2 to 3 weeks; "key investment platforms" to go live "soon" | [Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/press) |
| Oct 2026 (after 16 Oct) | Deals / Hires / Launches | No dated item identified in the provided sources | Not applicable |

The IFSCA release is the only in-window item in the provided press index. Its claim about integration timelines is a company statement and has not been independently verified. The company also states that key investment platforms will go live "soon," but gives no dates or named partners in the excerpt provided ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/press)).

**Gap note:** The press index lists items with a date of 5 October 2026 or earlier, and the Oct 5 OpenAI partnership sits just outside the window. The MitchelLake page also lists a product launch dated 1 October 2026 and a partnership dated 5 October 2026, but their titles and details are not in the provided excerpt ([MitchelLake, 2026](https://mitchellake.com/intelligence/wire/razorpay-strategic-hiring-2026-08-08)). Before the meeting, confirm whether any in-window items exist beyond those listed here.

---

## Context: Developments Before the Window

These items sit outside the 30-day window but explain the current trajectory.

| Date | Category | Development | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 Oct 2026 | Partnership | Partnership with OpenAI to expand ChatGPT Ads in India; Razorpay Engage to let local brands run and track campaigns, with Tanishq, Titan, Tata Neu, and Axis Max Life among early participants | [Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/press) |
| 30 Sep 2026 | Product | Merchants can accept Apple Pay online and in-store without card entry or OTPs | [Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/press) |
| 2 Sep 2026 | Product | RAY, a conversational AI account manager on WhatsApp, launched with IndusInd Bank; Bajaj Finance among the first live businesses | [Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/press) |
| 18 Aug 2026 | Product / AI | Vulcan, described as India's first AI payments foundation model, built with NVIDIA and AWS and trained on 4 billion transactions | [Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/press) |
| 17 Feb 2026 | Partnership | Payments partner for Replit's global AI platform, targeting India-based AI builders | [Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/razorpay-becomes-the-india-payments-partner-for-replits-global-ai-platform) |
| 22 Apr 2026 | Product | Claims to be the first Indian payment aggregator to enable card payments through Google Pay for businesses worldwide | [Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/press) |

Note that the Oct 5 and Sep 30 entries are headline-level only in the provided excerpts. Details beyond the headlines are limited.

---

## Leadership and Talent

- **AI leadership hires (dated 8 August 2026):** Sudhir Reddy (from Divyam.ai), Abhishek Agarwal (from Microsoft), Bhavya Shivaprakash (from Salesforce), and Anuj Mathur (from CRED) were appointed to strengthen AI leadership ([MitchelLake, 2026](https://mitchellake.com/intelligence/wire/razorpay-strategic-hiring-2026-08-08)).
- **Stated purpose:** Analytics India Magazine reports that CTO and Co-founder Shashank Kumar said the hires would help build "AI-native financial infrastructure for businesses worldwide." Reddy is positioned to lead AI and data architecture ([Analytics India Magazine, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/analytics-india-magazine_razorpay-ai-fintech-activity-7490353347590311936-jESz)).
- **Engineering leadership:** Praburam (Prabu) Rambadran joined as Senior Vice President of Engineering in September 2025 ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/razorpay-strengthens-tech-leadership-appoints-ex-google-leader-prabu-rambadran-as-sr-vice-president-engineering); [Analytics India Magazine, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/analytics-india-magazine_razorpay-ai-fintech-activity-7490353347590311936-jESz)).
- **Executive appointment (dated 15 May 2026):** Apuarv Sethi was elevated to Chief Marketing Officer, with responsibility for brand and business momentum across India and Southeast Asia ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/press)).
- **North America:** A CEO for North America was announced in September 2025 to lead the U.S. SMB expansion ([Wenham Carter, 2025](https://www.wenhamcarter.com/razorpay-appoints-ceo-north-america-to-spearhead-expansion-redefining-payments-and-financial-services-for-u-s-smbs)).

The MitchelLake note records two Razorpay signals in the prior 90 days, above the Fintech median of one across 64 tracked companies ([MitchelLake, 2026](https://mitchellake.com/intelligence/wire/razorpay-strategic-hiring-2026-08-08)). That metric is third-party and its methodology is not described in the excerpt.

---

## Company Profile and Market Position

| Attribute | Reported Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Headquarters | Bengaluru, India | [Built In, 2026](https://builtin.com/company/razorpay/faq/leadership-management) |
| Founded | 2013 | [Built In, 2026](https://builtin.com/company/razorpay/faq/leadership-management) |
| Total employees | 3,200 | [Built In, 2026](https://builtin.com/company/razorpay/faq/leadership-management) |
| Annual processing | "$150B+" for "10M+ businesses" (company-reported) | [Wenham Carter, 2025](https://www.wenhamcarter.com/razorpay-appoints-ceo-north-america-to-spearhead-expansion-redefining-payments-and-financial-services-for-u-s-smbs) |
| Capital raised | "$750M+" (company-reported) | [Wenham Carter, 2025](https://www.wenhamcarter.com/razorpay-appoints-ceo-north-america-to-spearhead-expansion-redefining-payments-and-financial-services-for-u-s-smbs) |
| Acquisitions | "15+" | [Wenham Carter, 2025](https://www.wenhamcarter.com/razorpay-appoints-ceo-north-america-to-spearhead-expansion-redefining-payments-and-financial-services-for-u-s-smbs) |
| SEA footprint | Malaysia (2022), Singapore (March 2025); plans for 3 to 4 more SEA markets by end-2026 | [Built In, n.d.](https://builtin.com/company/razorpay/faq/stability-growth) |

Built In reports that Razorpay is seen as controlling a leading share of India's online payment gateway market and that FY24 and FY25 revenue and TPV grew, though it does not give figures in the excerpt ([Built In, n.d.](https://builtin.com/company/razorpay/faq/stability-growth)). The Built In leadership page notes the company completed a "reverse flip" to India, secured RBI Payment Aggregator authorisation, and integrated offline acceptance through Ezetap ([Built In, 2026](https://builtin.com/company/razorpay/faq/leadership-management)).

**Reliability note:** The Built In pages are aggregated content. The leadership page states it "has not been reviewed or approved by Razorpay." Treat these as directional, not audited.

---

## Commercial Offer: The 90-Day 0% Platform Fee

Razorpay's blog describes a 90-day 0% platform fee offer for new merchants. Key terms, as the blog presents them:

- **Eligibility:** KYC and activation must be completed on or after 1 July 2026 (Clause 1) ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026)).
- **One redemption per PAN or bank account:** Only the first activated Merchant ID qualifies (Clause 7) ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026)).
- **Prior transactors excluded:** Merchants who transacted on Razorpay before 1 July 2026 are disqualified (Clause 8) ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026)).
- **Cap:** ₹5,00,000 in Amount Credits; the offer can end early if the cap is exhausted first ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026)).
- **Exclusions:** Prepaid cards, corporate credit cards, AMEX, Diners Club, and all EMI-based methods carry standard fees (Clause 5) ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026)).
- **Lapse:** Unused credits lapse at day 90 and cannot be carried forward or redeemed for cash (Clause 10) ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026)).

The blog's illustrative math: at roughly ₹1 lakh monthly GMV, a 2% fee plus 18% GST comes to about ₹28,320 a year ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026)). This calculation is consistent with those stated rates (₹24,000 fee plus ₹4,320 GST on ₹12 lakh annual GMV).

The blog also states that UPI accounts for 85.5% of digital payment volume ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026)). This is a company-cited figure without an underlying source in the excerpt.

**Gap note:** The blog is undated and says the offer terms, dates, and caps are governed by the live terms. The offer's end date and whether it is still open to new cohorts could not be verified from the provided material.

---

## Other Items Noted

- **Potential IPO:** A YouTube video titled "Upcoming IPO in November 2026" is in the source set ([Stock Market Tak, n.d.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dxIAx-syEGo)). The excerpt contains only the title and platform boilerplate. Built In describes an "IPO-ready posture" ([Built In, 2026](https://builtin.com/company/razorpay/faq/leadership-management)). **We could not verify any IPO filing, date, or price range.** Do not rely on the video title.
- **Agentic payments:** Analytics India Magazine reports that since September 2025, Razorpay has shipped Agentic Payments, Agent Studio, and Connected Banking Agents ([Analytics India Magazine, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/analytics-india-magazine_razorpay-ai-fintech-activity-7490353347590311936-jESz)).
- **Events:** Razorpay's GFF 2026 presence (9 to 11 September) featured an SME Connect Platform with IndusInd Bank and an AI account manager on WhatsApp ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/m/gff2026)). These are older and already covered above.
- **Excluded source:** A job-preparation site (knok.work) appeared in the source set. It contains interview advice and promotional content and is not a business source, so it has been excluded.

---

## Our Assessment

1. **Strategic direction is clear, but the evidence is mostly self-reported.** The IFSCA licence is a concrete regulatory milestone, and the sequence of AI hires (August), AI product launches (August to September), and AI-linked partnerships (October) is consistent with a stated AI-native positioning. Independent confirmation of product adoption or revenue impact is absent from the sources.

2. **The IFSCA licence matters most for cross-border ambitions.** If the integration-timeline claim holds (months to 2 to 3 weeks), it could lower the cost of cross-border onboarding for Razorpay's clients. This is the claim most worth testing in the meeting.

3. **The 0% offer is a customer-acquisition lever with built-in limits.** The exclusions (premium cards and EMI) and the prior-transactor rule mean the offer targets genuinely new, low-volume merchants. Its economic value is capped at ₹5,00,000 and ends at day 90, so it is unlikely to shift a mid-sized merchant's long-run cost base.

4. **Information gaps limit confidence.** Only one item falls inside the 30-day window. The press index shows no deals or hires in that period. Before the meeting, verify whether anything else was announced between 16 October and 15 November.

---

## Three Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **GIFT City timeline:** Which "key investment platforms" will go live first under the IFSCA licence, and what is the expected date? How much of the claimed 2 to 3 week integration timeline applies to clients outside India?

2. **Offer eligibility and continuity:** How does Razorpay verify the one-MID-per-PAN-or-bank rule (Clause 7) for groups with multiple legal entities, and will the 0% offer remain open to new cohorts beyond the current terms?

3. **Monetisation of AI products:** How does Razorpay plan to price Agentic Payments, Agent Studio, and Vulcan-based services, and what share of revenue do these products represent today?

---

runs.briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Razorpay, 17 November 2026

**Window covered:** roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026. Sources are dated up to 14 November 2026.

## Regulatory and IPO

- India's market regulator, SEBI, gave Razorpay its approval for an IPO, according to a SEBI document reported on Friday, 13 November 2026. The firm had confidentially filed draft papers in June for an IPO sized at about $600 million, per Reuters. (https://www.thehindu.com/business/indian-fintech-firm-razorpay-gets-regulatory-nod-for-ipo/article71698143.ece)
- SEBI issued its final observations on Razorpay's draft offer documents on 3 November. (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms)
- Razorpay's shareholders approved a fresh issue of shares worth Rs 2,700 crore, plus an offer for sale (OFS) that lets existing investors partly sell their holdings. Axis Capital, JPMorgan, Citi and Kotak Mahindra Capital are advising on the deal. (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms)
- Inc42 headlined the approval as a ₹6,000 crore IPO. (https://inc42.com/buzz/razorpay-gets-sebi-nod-for-%E2%82%B96000-cr-ipo)
- Before approval, Upstox reported an expected raise of ₹5,000 to ₹6,000 crore, with price band and structure to follow the RHP filing. (https://upstox.com/news/market-news/ipo/upcoming-ip-os-mahanadi-coalfields-oyo-cult-fit-carlsberg-india-are-among-big-ticket-ip-os-expected-after-jio-platforms-listing/article-202719)

**Note on figures:** The reported deal size varies by source. The Rs 2,700 crore fresh issue, the ₹5,000–6,000 crore range and the ₹6,000 crore headline are not yet reconciled.

## Licences and product

- Razorpay received a final licence to expand cross-border payments from GIFT City. The source is a Business Standard page listing headlines, so the date and details come from that headline only. (https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/ifsca-proposes-model-portfolios-in-gift-city-by-research-entities-126110900766_1.html)

## Hires and headcount

- A company profile (undated) lists headcount at 4,033, down 16 over the year (-0.4%), down 23 over the quarter, and up 2 in the latest month. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/aJrBNen1btW7)
- I found no sourced news on senior hires or leadership changes in the window.

## Deals

- The only deal-related facts are the IPO advisers named above. I found no sourced news on acquisitions, partnerships or new major customers in the window.

## Open questions

1. **Offer size and structure:** What is the final split between fresh issue and OFS, and which total figure (₹2,700 crore fresh, ₹5,000–6,000 crore, or ₹6,000 crore) should we plan around?
2. **Timing:** When do you expect to file the RHP and open the book, and does the GIFT City cross-border licence change the use of IPO proceeds?
3. **Headcount:** The profile shows headcount falling over the past year and quarter. Is this a deliberate reduction, and what hiring plans sit behind the IPO?

No new contract with a disclosed value appears in the sources reviewed ([Economic Times, 2026](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms); [Stockfin, 2026](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/INFY/2026-10-19/announcement)).
- **The most consequential item is a workforce-mix strategy,** reported by the Times of India. Infosys reportedly plans to move up to one-third of about 320,000 employees into specialist roles and build a team of 6,000 "frontier engineers." This is based on press reporting of management remarks, not a company filing ([Times of India, n.d.](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)).
- **Regulatory and reputational items are live.** A 2026 French labour-related fine and a June 2026 report on hiring-test integrity are relevant background for talent and compliance discussions, though the French fine falls outside the 30-day window.
- **Share price is under pressure relative to its 52-week high,** trading near ₹1,145 on 13 November 2026 (derived; see verification notes) against a 52-week range of ₹980.40 to ₹1,728.00 ([Moneycontrol, 2026](https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-notices/infosys/notices/IT)).

## Recent Changes (Last 30 Days)

### News and Market Context

Infosys shares were volatile in late October. On 28 October 2026, Infosys, TechM, TCS and other IT stocks fell up to 5% as the global AI trade rebounded ([Economic Times, 2026](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms)). Sentiment improved in early November, with the Sensex gaining 1,233 points on 2 November, and foreign portfolio investors net buying roughly $1.2 billion over ten sessions, partly linked to reconsidering AI-related bets ([Economic Times, 2026](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms)).

On the earnings calendar, Stockfin reports that Infosys scheduled its Q2 results for 23 October 2026, with a press conference and earnings call that day ([Stockfin, 2026](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/INFY/2026-10-19/announcement)). An earnings call transcript was filed on 28 October under Regulation 30 ([Economic Times, 2026](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms)). **The Q2 revenue, margin and guidance figures are not in the sources reviewed and must be checked against the filing before the meeting.**

### Hiring and Workforce

- **Specialist-role shift and talent build.** Management reportedly told partners and analysts at the three-day Americas Confluence in Washington, DC, that up to one-third of 320,000 employees could move into specialist roles and that it would build a team of 6,000 frontier engineers. Infosys said it had not restructured, which analysts noted differs from many peers ([Times of India, n.d.](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). The article reports that Infosys is recruiting from leading Indian institutes and US campuses, often competing with AI labs for the same candidates ([Times of India, n.d.](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)).

These posts are roughly three to four months old and fall outside the 30-day window.
- **Compliance-related hiring issue.** Wikipedia cites a Times of India report of 9 June 2026 on impersonation and cheating that paused hiring tests ([Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infosys)). Only the headline was available, so the details are unverified and the item is outside the window.

## Analyst Assessment

1. **Infosys is pursuing a talent-mix pivot, not a headline headcount cut.** The management message of "no restructuring" combined with a plan to move a third of staff into specialist roles suggests the company is trying to change skill composition while keeping the workforce intact. The reported redeployment of clients' surplus staff points in the same direction. If confirmed, this would be a more consequential strategic signal than any single contract announced this month.
2. **The growth signal is real but thinly documented.** The Truist GCC is a clean, filed win with a stated headcount, which supports the case for captive-style delivery in India. But with no disclosed contract value and no other sized deals in the window, the month does not show accelerating large-deal momentum. The Q2 figures, which were not available in the sources, will matter more than the press flow.
3. **Compliance and talent-process risk warrants a direct question.** The French working-time finding concerns how Infosys records employee hours, and the June hiring-test report concerns candidate integrity. Neither is material on its own, but both touch the talent processes the company is relying on for the specialist-role plan.

## Three Open Questions to Ask

1. **What is the timeline and funding for the specialist-role transition?** Specifically, how many of the 6,000 frontier engineer roles are filled, what reskilling investment is planned, and how does the redeployment of clients' surplus staff affect utilization and margins in the next two quarters?
2. **What is the scale and ramp of the Truist GCC and the wider pipeline of GCC mandates?** Can Infosys quantify the contract value, the 1,000-employee onboarding schedule, and the expected conversion of current large-deal discussions into signed contracts?
3. **How is Infosys remediating the French working-time recording finding and the hiring-test integrity issue?** What changes have been made to timekeeping systems and assessment controls, and are any further regulatory exposures expected in the coming quarter?

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Infosys, 17 November 2026

**Window covered:** 18 October to 17 November 2026
**Sources:** Search results provided only. Items are listed by date.

## Summary
Infosys's Q2 FY27 results (23 October) disappointed the market. Revenue grew 1.3% year over year, and management lowered annual revenue growth guidance. Shares fell sharply afterward. Since then, the company has announced expansion in Hyderabad and Bengaluru-area capacity, and it has signaled investor outreach in the UK.

## What changed

**Results and guidance**
- Q2 revenue was $5,145M, up 1.3% YoY (1.5% in constant currency). AI revenue grew 29% sequentially and reached 10.5% of revenue. Operating margin was 21.0%. Large-deal TCV was $5.2B, 62% of it net new, including one deal above $2B. (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/INFY/infosys-differentiated-ai-strategy-and-a-sharp-focus-on-value-unlock-sjalje8xfokm.html)
- Infosys lowered its annual revenue growth guidance. The ADR fell over 7%, and the NSE share price closed at ₹1,153.8 on the prior Friday. (https://upstox.com/news/market-news/stocks/infosys-adr-falls-over-7-as-it-major-lowers-annual-revenue-growth-guidance-everything-investors-need-to-know/article-202325)
- Infosys reported a North America revenue decline amid sector slowdowns. (https://www.scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108) *(headline only; full article not in results)*
- Shares fell 6.5% after Q2 EPS missed estimates by $0.01. (https://www.scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108) *(headline only)*
- BMO Capital raised its price target to $13 and maintained Market Perform. (https://www.scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108) *(headline only)*

**Markets**
- A block trade of ₹69.49 crore was executed on the NSE on 23 October. (https://www.scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108) *(headline only)*
- Shares slid over 2% on 2 November, and the Hyderabad campus expansion did not lift sentiment. (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece)

**Hires and capacity**
- Infosys expanded its Truist GCC in India and onboarded 1,000 colleagues. (https://www.scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108) *(headline only)*
- Infosys opened a new 1.1M sq ft block at its Pocharam campus in Hyderabad to serve emerging technologies. (https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/hyderabad/infosys-sets-up-new-1-1m-sq-ft-block-at-pocharam-campus-in-hyderabad-to-cater-to-emerging-technologies/articleshow/135366954.cms)
- At the Hyderabad campus inauguration, Infosys said it serves banking, retail, life sciences and manufacturing clients. It employs over 325,000 people across 59 countries. (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece)

**Investor relations and events**
- Management will attend non-deal investor roadshows in London and Edinburgh in November. Exact dates were cut off in the results. (https://www.scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108)
- The Infosys Prize 2026 winners were announced on 12 November in Bengaluru. This is a foundation award, not a commercial event. (https://news.careers360.com/infosys-prize-2026-scholars-from-tifr-princeton-carnegie-mellon-uc-san-ranscisco-new-south-wales-singapore-universities-winners)

**Launches:** No product or service launches were found in the results.

## Gaps
- Full texts exist only for the Hyderabad, Pocharam, Q2 results and ADR articles. Other items are headlines.
- The company profile page is undated and was not used for recent changes. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/Gbd7vUUlzCYP)

## Open questions
1. **Guidance:** What drove the cut to annual revenue growth guidance, and how much of the North America decline is sector-wide versus Infosys-specific? What does the Q3 outlook assume?
2. **Deals and AI:** Of the $5.2B large-deal TCV (62% net new), how much will convert to revenue, and on what timeline? What is the path for AI revenue beyond 10.5% of total?
3. **Capacity and roadshows:** Is the new Hyderabad and Pocharam capacity ahead of demand, and how does hiring (such as the 1,000 Truist GCC onboardings) fit a slower growth outlook? What investor messages will management take to London and Edinburgh, and on what dates?

# Infosys: Pre-Meeting Briefing for 17 November 2026

**Prepared:** 15 November 2026
**Review window:** 16 October to 15 November 2026
**Scope:** News, product and platform activity, executive and talent moves, deals and partnerships, and market reaction

## Executive Summary

Infosys's last 30 days were dominated by incremental client, facility, and corporate-governance announcements rather than a single major transaction. The most consequential items are the workforce-reshaping plan reported from the company's Americas Confluence, the Truist partnership that expands its Hyderabad delivery footprint, and the naming of a CEO-designate. Market sentiment was volatile: IT stocks fell sharply on 28 October before the stock traded near the lower part of its 52-week range in mid-November ([Economic Times, 2026a](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms); [Moneycontrol, 2026](https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-notices/infosys/notices/IT)). Several items that would normally matter (Q2 FY27 results content, the CEO transition timeline, and salary-revision details) could not be verified from the provided sources and should be confirmed before the meeting.

## Material Changes in the Last 30 Days

### News and Corporate Announcements

Infosys scheduled its second-quarter earnings release for 23 October 2026, with a press conference at 4:30 p.m. IST and an earnings call at 6:00 p.m. IST ([StockFin, 2026](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/INFY/2026-10-19/announcement)). The provided sources do not include the reported revenue, margin, or guidance figures, so the quarter's financial performance is **unverified** in this briefing.

Other filings and disclosures in the window included:

| Date | Disclosure | Source |
|---|---|---|
| 28 Oct 2026 | Regulation 30 (LODR) earnings call transcript filed | [Economic Times, 2026a](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms) |
| 30 Oct 2026 | Expansion of Pocharam Development Center, Hyderabad (filing enclosed; details not in source) | [Economic Times, 2026a](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms) |
| 4 Nov 2026 | Infosys Investor Conference announcement (filing enclosed; details not in source) | [Economic Times, 2026a](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms) |
| 12 Nov 2026 | Six researchers named winners of the Infosys Prize 2026 by the Infosys Science Foundation | [Moneycontrol, 2026](https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-notices/infosys/notices/IT) |

The Economic Times also reported that Infosys was among more than 40 companies with record dates for dividends, bonus issues, rights issues, or stock splits during 2–6 November 2026 ([Economic Times, 2026b](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms)). The provided sources do not state the specific corporate action that applied to Infosys.

### Product and Platform Activity

No new named product launch within the window could be verified from the provided sources. The closest verifiable item is client-facing platform deployment: Infosys announced that Canada's UNI Financial Cooperation is advancing branch modernization with the Infosys Finacle Universal Banker ([Economic Times, 2026a](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms)). Infosys also announced the winners of the Qorus-Infosys Finacle Banking Innovation Awards 2026 on 29 October ([Economic Times, 2026a](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms)).

### Executive and Talent Changes

The most material people-related item is the leadership transition. Per the Times of India, CEO-designate Ashiss Kumar Dash and incumbent CEO Salil Parekh shared the stage at the Americas Confluence in Washington, DC, where discussion centred on generating value from AI ([Times of India, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). **The effective date of Dash's appointment is not stated in the provided sources and is unverified.**

Workforce strategy was the second major theme. According to the Times of India, Infosys plans to move up to one-third of its roughly 320,000 employees into specialist roles and build a team of 6,000 "frontier engineers" as AI reshapes IT work ([Times of India, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). The same report states that Infosys said it has not restructured, and that it is recruiting from leading Indian institutes and US campuses, often competing with AI labs for the same candidates ([Times of India, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). The analyst quoted in that report says that in some deals Infosys is taking on clients' surplus staff and redeploying them ([Times of India, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)).

A People Matters post, which appears to predate the window, reports that Infosys announced a phased salary revision beginning in October and reaffirmed its commitment to hire 20,000 freshers in the current financial year ([People Matters, 2026](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/people-matters_infosys-leadership-futureofwork-activity-7486351991623864320-xVwR)). **The post's exact date and the revision's scope are unverified.**

### Deals and Partnerships

| Date | Counterparty | Activity | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 19 Oct 2026 | Truist | Expanded strategic partnership to build a Global Capability Center in Hyderabad, onboarding over 1,000 employees and consolidating multiple supplier relationships | [StockFin, 2026](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/INFY/2026-10-19/announcement) |
| 28 Oct 2026 | UNI Financial Cooperation (Canada) | Branch modernization using Finacle Universal Banker | [Economic Times, 2026a](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms) |

The Truist arrangement is the most significant commercial item in the window. It reflects a pattern of consolidating client vendor relationships into captive-style delivery centres, which tends to deepen account stickiness but also concentrates revenue in individual clients. The provided source does not disclose contract value or duration, so the financial scale is **unverified**.

## Market Performance

Infosys shares were caught in the broader IT sell-off. On 28 October, the Economic Times reported that Infosys, TechM, TCS and other IT stocks fell up to 5% as the global AI trade rebounded ([Economic Times, 2026a](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms)). Foreign portfolio investors then shifted to net buying of Indian equities, investing nearly $1.2 billion over the previous ten trading sessions, which the report links partly to changing views on AI-related bets ([Economic Times, 2026b](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms)).

As of 13 November 2026, Moneycontrol showed a day change of -9.70 (-0.84%), a day range of ₹1,135.50 to ₹1,155.00, and a 52-week range of ₹980.40 to ₹1,728.00 ([Moneycontrol, 2026](https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-notices/infosys/notices/IT)). The displayed share price is partly garbled in the source, so the exact closing price should be confirmed on the exchange. StockFin reports a market capitalisation of ₹4.66 lakh crore, ranking Infosys second of the 20 IT-Software companies it tracks ([StockFin, 2026](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/INFY/2026-10-19/announcement)).

## Context Outside the 30-Day Window

These items are relevant background but fall outside the review window:

- **Columbia University partnership (1 October 2026):** Infosys and Columbia launched the Infosys Topaz – Columbia University Enterprise AI Center, led by Columbia Engineering ([Unite.AI, 2026](https://www.unite.ai/infosys-and-columbia-university-launch-enterprise-ai-research-center)).
- **Q4 FY26 results (23 April 2026):** Wikipedia reports financials as of 31 March 2026, including total assets of ₹155,967 crore (US$17 billion) and 328,594 employees ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infosys)).
- **French labour fine (July 2026):** Wikipedia reports that DRIEETS Île-de-France fined Infosys €175,000 after its working-time recording system was found to breach French labour rules ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infosys)). A Deccan Herald report cited on the same page describes a separate Rs 2 crore fine over time tracking of employees ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infosys)).
- **NHS contract (14 October 2025):** Reuters reported a $1.6 billion deal from the UK's National Health Service, as cited on Wikipedia ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infosys)). This is over a year old and is included only for context.

| 320,000 headcount (Times of India) vs. 328,594 (Wikipedia, March 2026) | Figures differ and dates differ | Confirm current headcount |
| Salary revision and 20,000 fresher hiring | Source post appears older than the window; exact dates unclear | Verify with HR communications |
| Dividend/bonus/split record date | Infosys named in the list, but corporate action type not specified | Confirm the action and its status |
| Investor Conference (4 Nov) and Pocharam expansion (30 Oct) | Filing titles only; no details in provided sources | Retrieve the filings |
| Share price on 13 Nov | Source value partly garbled | Confirm on NSE/BSE |
| YouTube interview with Salil Parekh | Title only; content not accessible | Review full video before citing |
| PW Skills blog (22 Oct 2026) | Commercial course provider; not a reliable source for Infosys corporate facts | Excluded from factual analysis |

## Analyst View

In my assessment, the most important development for the meeting is not any single announcement but the **combination of workforce reshaping and leadership transition**. Infosys is pursuing a redeployment-led strategy, moving existing staff into specialist roles and absorbing clients' surplus staff, while publicly stating it has not restructured. This approach protects headcount and client relationships, but it depends on execution speed and on whether specialist demand materialises at the scale the company is targeting. The Truist partnership supports the same logic: consolidating vendor relationships into dedicated centres increases switching costs.

The market appears to be pricing in uncertainty. The share price sits roughly 17% above its 52-week low and 34% below its high, which suggests that investors are not yet convinced that AI-driven change will translate into durable growth ([Moneycontrol, 2026](https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-notices/infosys/notices/IT)). My view is that the company's narrative is credible on positioning, but the evidence for growth acceleration is not visible in the material reviewed here. Until the Q2 figures and the CEO transition timeline are confirmed, I would treat the positive signals as directional rather than proven.

## Open Questions

1. What were Infosys's Q2 FY27 revenue growth, operating margin, and guidance changes, and how much of the planned redeployment of the 320,000-person workforce is already reflected in those numbers?
2. When will Ashiss Kumar Dash formally assume the CEO role, and what changes to strategy, delivery model, or the Truist-type client partnerships should clients expect during the transition?
3. What is the current status of the phased salary revision and the 20,000-fresher hiring commitment, and how are the specialist-role transition and the 6,000 "frontier engineer" target being measured?

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Infosys, 17 November 2026

**Window covered:** 18 October to 17 November 2026. Sources are limited to the search results provided.

**Company snapshot:** Infosys is an IT services and consulting company headquartered in Bangalore, founded in 1981 (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/Gbd7vUUlzCYP). It employs over 325,000 people and operates in 59 countries (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece).

## What changed in the last 30 days

**Financial results (Q2, quarter ended 30 Sep 2026)**
- Revenue was $5,145 million. AI revenue grew 29% sequentially and makes up 10.5% of revenue. Reported revenue rose 1.3% year over year, and operating margin was 21.0% (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/INFY/infosys-differentiated-ai-strategy-and-a-sharp-focus-on-value-unlock-sjalje8xfokm.html).
- Constant-currency growth was 1.5% year over year and 1.2% sequentially (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/INFY/infosys-differentiated-ai-strategy-and-a-sharp-focus-on-value-unlock-sjalje8xfokm.html).
- The company lowered its annual revenue growth guidance. The ADR fell over 7% on 23 October (https://upstox.com/news/market-news/stocks/infosys-adr-falls-over-7-as-it-major-lowers-annual-revenue-growth-guidance-everything-investors-need-to-know/article-202325).
- A headline reports that shares fell 6.5% after Q2 EPS missed estimates by $0.01 (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108, dated 27 October).

**Launches and expansion**
- Infosys set up a new 1.1 million sq ft block at its Pocharam campus in Hyderabad to serve emerging technologies (https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/hyderabad/infosys-sets-up-new-1-1m-sq-ft-block-at-pocharam-campus-in-hyderabad-to-cater-to-emerging-technologies/articleshow/135366954.cms, 30 October).
- The Hyderabad campus was inaugurated with Telangana's Deputy Chief Minister, the IT Minister and CFO Jayesh Sanghrajka present. The facility targets banking, retail, life sciences and manufacturing clients and includes radiant cooling and rainwater harvesting (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece). Shares slid over 2% on the day (same source, 2 November).

**Investor relations**
- Management will attend non-deal roadshows in London and Edinburgh in November (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).

**Deals**
- Large-deal total contract value reached $5.2 billion, with 62% net new. This included one deal above $2 billion (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/INFY/infosys-differentiated-ai-strategy-and-a-sharp-focus-on-value-unlock-sjalje8xfokm.html).

**Other**
- The Infosys Science Foundation announced the 2026 Infosys Prize on 12 November. Each award carries USD 100,000 (https://news.careers360.com/infosys-prize-2026-scholars-from-tifr-princeton-carnegie-mellon-uc-san-ranscisco-new-south-wales-singapore-universities-winners). This is reputational, not commercial.

**Not included:** Headlines on a Truist GCC expansion (1,000 hires), a BMO price-target change, North America revenue decline, and a block trade appeared in the results without source URLs, so I did not use them. No hiring or deal facts beyond those above could be verified.

## Open questions

1. Q2 guidance was lowered. What drove the cut, and which segments or geographies do you expect to recover first?
2. Large-deal TCV was $5.2 billion, with 62% net new. How much of that is expected to convert to revenue in the next two quarters, and how does that affect your view of the revenue outlook?
3. AI revenue grew 29% sequentially to 10.5% of total revenue. What share of AI revenue are you targeting for the next fiscal year, and how will you report it going forward?

# Zepto: Pre-Meeting Briefing for 17 November 2026

## Executive Summary

Zepto's most recent verifiable financing data points to a valuation reset. Multiples records a $4.5B valuation in an undisclosed-stage round in August 2026, down from $7B in October 2025, while recorded revenue rose to $2.4B ([Multiples, n.d.](https://multiples.vc/private-comps/zepto)). The IPO planned for July 2026 has no confirmed status in the sources reviewed ([Business Standard, 2026](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/zepto-plans-to-float-rs-11000-crore-ipo-in-july-126052100806_1.html)). No product launch, partnership, or senior executive appointment dated within the last 30 days (16 October to 15 November 2026) could be confirmed from the provided sources. The clearest in-window signal is an active hiring drive for delivery roles ([Apna, 2026](https://apna.co/jobs/zepto-jobs)).

## Scope, Date Window, and Source Reliability

This briefing covers the 30 days preceding the current date of 15 November 2026. Several sources are older and are used only as background. Source quality varies:

| Source type | Examples | Reliability assessment |
|---|---|---|
| Wire and national business press | Reuters via Yahoo Finance; Business Standard (PTI); Economic Times | High, but some items are older or report unnamed "people familiar" |
| Market research and data aggregators | Multiples; Tracxn | Medium. Figures conflict across aggregators and some are stale |
| Job boards and career sites | Apna; Hirist | Medium for hiring activity; low for corporate facts |
| LLM-derived or user-generated summaries | Built In; Unify | Low. Built In states it has not been reviewed by Zepto |

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### News and Market Developments

- **Competitive landscape.** Blinkit and Zepto face expansion by Amazon (Amazon Now) and Flipkart (Flipkart Minutes) into electronics, beauty, and festive categories. Redseer projects the quick-commerce market at $70–90 billion by FY31 ([BW Marketing World, 2026](https://www.bwmarketingworld.com/article/quick-commerce-enters-bigger-basket-battle-as-blinkit-zepto-face-amazon-flipkart-627434)). This article is dated 8 October 2026, just before the window, but it is the most recent market-level analysis available.
- **Festive demand.** Quick commerce accounted for around 11% of festive e-commerce spend in 2025 and could reach nearly 18% in 2026. Festive quick-commerce GMV is projected to grow 110–120% year on year, against 16–18% for the rest of e-commerce ([BW Marketing World, 2026](https://www.bwmarketingworld.com/article/quick-commerce-enters-bigger-basket-battle-as-blinkit-zepto-face-amazon-flipkart-627434)). These are third-party projections, not Zepto disclosures.
- **Workforce scale (background).** Zepto's India People Experience head oversees more than 300,000 personnel, including over 50,000 associates and 250,000 riders, across more than 1,000 stores and facilities ([Apparel Resources, 2026](https://apparelresources.com/business-news/retail/zepto-strengthens-leadership-sushant-s-appointment)). This was reported in June 2026, outside the window.
- **Reported ED case.** The Economic Times page carries a "Zepto ED case" topic tag, but the article content supplied does not confirm any enforcement action. ⚠ **Unverified; do not treat as fact.** ([Economic Times, 2026](https://m.economictimes.com/industry/services/retail/customers-will-feast-as-zepto-to-pour-fuel-into-quick-commerce-fire/articleshow/131605658.cms))

### Product Launches

⚠ **No product launch dated within the window was confirmed in the provided sources.** The only related item is a Unify headline, "Zepto beyond Groceries," dated 29 September 2026, which describes the app becoming a broader shopping destination but is outside the window and lacks detail ([Unify, 2026](https://www.unifygtm.com/insights/executives/zepto-ceo)).

### Executive and Key Hires

- **CEO.** Aadit Palicha remains CEO and co-founder, and has led the company since 2021 ([Unify, 2026](https://www.unifygtm.com/insights/executives/zepto-ceo)).
- **Senior appointment (background).** Sushant S. was appointed Director and India Head for People Experience, Workforce Governance, Enterprise Transformation, and Operations Strategy in June 2026, outside the window ([Apparel Resources, 2026](https://apparelresources.com/business-news/retail/zepto-strengthens-leadership-sushant-s-appointment)).
- **In-window hires.** ⚠ **No Zepto executive appointment within the window was found.** The LinkedIn "Top Hires" roundup provided is dated March 2026 and does not mention Zepto ([LinkedIn, 2026](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/top-hires-from-march-2026-leadership-announcements-c7ihc)).
- **Frontline hiring (in-window).** The Apna listing shows 183 verified vacancies, including Delivery Partner and Delivery Executive roles in Pune (₹50,000–80,000 per month, as listed), New Delhi, Nagpur, and Coimbatore. Many roles are marked "Urgently hiring" and require no English ([Apna, 2026](https://apna.co/jobs/zepto-jobs)). This shows ongoing frontline expansion, though the listed salary band is not verified against Zepto's own disclosures.
- **Employer sentiment.** Hirist shows a 3.6 out of 5 rating from 3,100 reviews. Cluster Manager roles score lowest at 3.1, and Shift Incharge roles highest at 3.9 ([Hirist, 2026](https://www.hirist.tech/zepto-careers)).

### Partnerships and Deals

⚠ **No partnership or deal dated within the window was confirmed in the provided sources.** The most recent financing event listed is an undisclosed-stage round of $105M in August 2026, led by General Catalyst with Glade Brook Capital Partners, Goodwater Capital, and Nexus Venture Partners ([Multiples, n.d.](https://multiples.vc/private-comps/zepto)). This is outside the 30-day window but is the latest capital event.

## Financing and IPO Trajectory

| Date | Event | Valuation | Revenue (as recorded) | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Oct 2025 | Series H, $450M (per Inc42 post, led by CalPERS) | $7B | $1.3B | [Inc42, 2025](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/inc42_newsmakers-activity-7385629592016994304-qiGI); [Multiples, n.d.](https://multiples.vc/private-comps/zepto) |
| Dec 2025 | Confidential IPO filing (₹110B, ~$1.22B) | Not stated | Not stated | [Reuters, 2025](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indias-quick-commerce-company-zepto-074521951.html) |
| May 2026 | Report of ₹11,000-crore IPO planned for July | Not stated | Not stated | [Business Standard, 2026](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/zepto-plans-to-float-rs-11000-crore-ipo-in-july-126052100806_1.html) |
| Aug 2026 | Undisclosed round, $105M | $4.5B | $2.4B | [Multiples, n.d.](https://multiples.vc/private-comps/zepto) |

**Data conflicts.** Sources disagree on total funding. Multiples reports $2.6B across 14 rounds ([Multiples, n.d.](https://multiples.vc/private-comps/zepto)), while Tracxn reports $2.29B across 14 rounds and lists the latest priced round as an Oct 2025 Series H of $300M ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/companies/zepto/__vOTzafGt-8S4kwYniiZ_yRogd6c_Jsw_vRD0gckHtfE/funding-and-investors)). Tracxn's valuation of ₹61,100 crore is dated 4 November 2025, so it is stale. Built In lists Zepto's headquarters as Carlsbad, which conflicts with Multiples and Reuters, both of which place it in Bengaluru ([Built In, 2026](https://builtin.com/company/zepto/faq/leadership-management)). Built In's data is unreviewed and should be disregarded for corporate facts.

## Analysis and Our View

**View 1: The valuation has reset downward, and the IPO timing has likely slipped.** Multiples implies a fall from $7B to $4.5B, a decline of roughly 36%, while recorded revenue rose from $1.3B to $2.4B ([Multiples, n.d.](https://multiples.vc/private-comps/zepto)). The revenue multiple fell from 5.6x to 1.9x. If the $4.5B figure is accurate, the company is likely pricing its IPO against a more conservative peer benchmark than its 2025 private marks. The July 2026 target has passed with no confirmed listing in the sources reviewed, so we treat the IPO as unconfirmed and likely delayed.

**View 2: Festive and non-grocery categories are the central competitive battleground in the near term.** Redseer's projections imply that festive quick-commerce growth will significantly outpace e-commerce, and that Amazon and Flipkart have advantages in electronics through brand relationships ([BW Marketing World, 2026](https://www.bwmarketingworld.com/article/quick-commerce-enters-bigger-basket-battle-as-blinkit-zepto-face-amazon-flipkart-627434)). Zepto's hyperlocal and dark-store expertise is its main defence. Its ability to win larger baskets, rather than only fast delivery, will determine whether the revenue growth in the aggregators' figures holds.

**View 3: The frontline hiring drive suggests operational expansion, but employer sentiment at management level is a risk.** The 183 open roles and "urgent hiring" tags indicate continued demand for delivery capacity ([Apna, 2026](https://apna.co/jobs/zepto-jobs)). The weaker ratings for Cluster Manager roles (3.1) relative to Shift Incharge roles (3.9) suggest that management layers may be the pressure point ([Hirist, 2026](https://www.hirist.tech/zepto-careers)).

## Data Gaps and Flags

- No verified product launch, partnership, or executive appointment dated within 16 October to 15 November 2026.
- IPO status after the July 2026 target is unknown.
- The "ED case" topic tag on the Economic Times page is unsupported by article content.
- The Apna salary range is advertised by the listing and is not verified.
- Funding totals and valuation dates conflict across Multiples and Tracxn.
- Built In's headquarters and employee data are unreviewed.

## Three Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **IPO status:** Has the IPO been deferred or revised from the July 2026 target, and if so, what valuation range and timeline is the company now considering in light of the $4.5B August 2026 mark?
2. **Festive and non-grocery strategy:** What share of festive 2026 GMV does Zepto expect from electronics, beauty, and other non-grocery categories, and how is it responding to Amazon Now and Flipkart Minutes?
3. **Frontline and management capacity:** How many of the currently advertised delivery and store roles are net new versus replacement, and what actions are underway to address management-level employee sentiment?

# Zepto: Pre-Meeting Briefing

**Meeting:** 17 November 2026
**Scope:** Changes in the 30 days before the meeting (about 18 Oct to 17 Nov 2026), based only on the search results provided.

## What changed (last 30 days)

**News and public sentiment**
- A viral video reported that a Zepto delivery partner received "cash-like coupons" instead of cash for a Diwali bonus, which drew criticism of the company's worker welfare and of startups that "exploit labour." (https://www.news18.com/viral/zeptos-diwali-bonus-video-goes-viral-delivery-partner-gets-cash-like-coupons-instead-of-money-peanuts-in-the-name-of-a-bonus-ws-l-10418467.html), 9 Nov 2026.
- Zepto advanced its post-Diwali company holiday from Tuesday to Monday, giving employees an extra day off. Chief HR officer Sneha Arora described the move as a way to give staff "a longer weekend." (https://m.economictimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/india-inc-lights-up-diwali-with-longer-weekends-flexible-work-and-extra-pay-for-festive-shifts/articleshow/135618893.cms), 8 Nov 2026.

**Launches and campaigns**
- Zepto delivered more than 14,000 gold and silver coins in one hour during Dhanteras 2026. Coverage describes strong festive order growth for gold, silver and household items across quick-commerce platforms. (https://indiabusinesstrade.in/dhanteras-2026-zepto-delivers-over-14000-gold-and-silver-coins-in-one-hour.htm), 8 Nov 2026.
- Zepto launched a fandom-led marketing campaign, "Zepto lands in Seoul Street," with Anime India said to be next. Chief brand officer Chandan Mendiratta is quoted, and fans are set to queue in Hyderabad on 14 November. Zepto has not said which fandom comes next. (https://www.animationxpress.com/latest-news/zepto-lands-in-seoul-street-anime-india-is-up-next-the-fans-got-there-years-ago), 21 Oct 2026.

**Hires**
- No hires were found in the results for this window.

**Deals and funding**
- No deals or funding rounds dated within the window were found. The only funding records are older: a USD 100M venture round dated 1 July 2026 and a USD 450M Series H dated 16 Nov 2025. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/YT08vmcifB58), undated profile.

## Background (not within 30 days)
- Zepto Marketplace Private Limited, founded 2021, privately held, B2C, headquartered in India. The profile lists it as Bengaluru-headquartered in the ET article above. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/YT08vmcifB58), undated.

## Gaps
- Results for the Zepto-named search also returned unrelated physics stories about the "zeptoverse," which I excluded.
- The News18 and India Business Trade articles were truncated in the results, so details beyond the headlines and opening paragraphs are unverified.

## Open questions
1. What is Zepto's response to the Diwali bonus complaints, and how are festive bonuses structured for delivery partners?
2. Following the Dhanteras gold and silver order growth, does Zepto plan to expand high-value categories beyond festive peaks, and what supports that?
3. Can you confirm the July 2026 funding round and how the company plans to use it, including the next fandom campaign after Anime India?

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### News and Market Context

Quick commerce is moving beyond grocery into electronics, beauty, festive purchases, and non-metro markets. The market is projected to reach $70–90 billion by FY31 (BW Online Bureau, 2026, October 8, [source](https://www.bwmarketingworld.com/article/quick-commerce-enters-bigger-basket-battle-as-blinkit-zepto-face-amazon-flipkart-627434)). Quick commerce accounted for around 11% of festive e-commerce spending in 2025 and could reach nearly 18% in 2026. Festive quick-commerce GMV is projected to grow 110–120% year on year, compared with 16–18% for the rest of e-commerce (BW Online Bureau, 2026, October 8, [source](https://www.bwmarketingworld.com/article/quick-commerce-enters-bigger-basket-battle-as-blinkit-zepto-face-amazon-flipkart-627434)).

Redseer's Kushal Bhatnagar argues that Amazon and Flipkart may hold an advantage in categories such as electronics, given their brand relationships and ability to combine assortment with faster fulfilment (BW Online Bureau, 2026, October 8, [source](https://www.bwmarketingworld.com/article/quick-commerce-enters-bigger-basket-battle-as-blinkit-zepto-face-amazon-flipkart-627434)). Zepto's stated strengths are hyperlocal fulfilment, dark-store networks, and rapid delivery (BW Online Bureau, 2026, October 8, [source](https://www.bwmarketingworld.com/article/quick-commerce-enters-bigger-basket-battle-as-blinkit-zepto-face-amazon-flipkart-627434)).

DoorDash's announced acquisition of Instacart, reported as October 2026, is a relevant adjacent move in grocery and local commerce delivery (Multiples, n.d., [source](https://multiples.vc/private-comps/zepto)). The exact announcement date is not confirmed in the sources.

### Product and Launches

**No verified Zepto product or launch announcement dated within the window was found.** A June 2026 Economic Times headline references Zepto pouring fuel into quick commerce, but the article body was not captured (The Economic Times, 2026, June 9, [source](https://m.economictimes.com/industry/services/retail/customers-will-feast-as-zepto-to-pour-fuel-into-quick-commerce-fire/articleshow/131605658.cms)). A September 2026 headline on Zepto's expansion beyond groceries also appears, but only as a headline (Unify, 2026, September 24, [source](https://www.unifygtm.com/insights/executives/zepto-ceo)).

### Hiring and Leadership

- **Frontline hiring is active.** The Apna.co listing shows 183 verified vacancies. Delivery-partner roles in Pune are marked "Urgently hiring" at ₹50,000–₹80,000, with delivery-executive roles in New Delhi, Nagpur, and Coimbatore (Apna.co, 2026, November, [source](https://apna.co/jobs/zepto-jobs)).

This appointment is outside the window.

- **CEO continuity.** Aadit Palicha is reported as CEO since 2021 (Unify, 2026, September 24, [source](https://www.unifygtm.com/insights/executives/zepto-ceo)).

### Deals and Funding

- **Most recent round:** A $105M undisclosed-stage round in August 2026, led by or including General Catalyst, Glade Brook Capital, Goodwater Capital, and Nexus Venture Partners, reportedly valued Zepto at $4.5B (Multiples, n.d., [source](https://multiples.vc/private-comps/zepto)). # Pre-Meeting Briefing: Zepto, 17 November 2026

**Window:** roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026. Sources are the search results provided; no other information was used.

## News and Public Sentiment

- **Diwali bonus backlash.** News18 reports that a Zepto Diwali bonus video went viral, with a headline saying a delivery partner received "cash-like coupons" instead of money. Commenters criticised the company for allegedly failing to provide adequate benefits to its workforce. (https://www.news18.com/viral/zeptos-diwali-bonus-video-goes-viral-delivery-partner-gets-cash-like-coupons-instead-of-money-peanuts-in-the-name-of-a-bonus-ws-l-10418467.html), dated 9 Nov 2026.
- **Extra holiday for staff.** The Economic Times reports Zepto moved its scheduled holiday from Tuesday to Monday, giving employees an extra day off after Diwali. Chief HR officer Sneha Arora said the aim was a longer festive weekend. (https://m.economictimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/india-inc-lights-up-diwali-with-longer-weekends-flexible-work-and-extra-pay-for-festive-shifts/articleshow/135618893.cms), dated 8 Nov 2026.

## Launches and Campaigns

- **Dhanteras sales spike.** India Business Trade reports Zepto delivered over 14,000 gold and silver coins in one hour during Dhanteras 2026. It describes strong festive order growth for gold, silver and household items across Zepto, Swiggy Instamart and Flipkart Minutes. (https://indiabusinesstrade.in/dhanteras-2026-zepto-delivers-over-14000-gold-and-silver-coins-in-one-hour.htm), dated 8 Nov 2026.
- **Seoul Street fandom campaign.** AnimationXpress reports Zepto launched a fandom-led campaign ("Seoul Street"), with chief brand officer Chandan Mendiratta quoted. Fans are expected at a Hyderabad event on 14 November. Zepto has not said which fandom comes next. (https://www.animationxpress.com/latest-news/zepto-lands-in-seoul-street-anime-india-is-up-next-the-fans-got-there-years-ago), dated 21 Oct 2026.

## Hires and Deals

- **No hires found** in the provided results within the window.
- **No deals found** within the window. A company profile lists a "Venture Round" of USD 100M dated 2026-07-01 and a "Series H" of USD 450M dated 2025-11-16. Both fall outside the 30-day window, and the profile is undated. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/YT08vmcifB58)

## Gaps

Results are thin on hiring and deals. The valuation claim in a social post quoted by News18 ("Zepto valuation 7 billion") is unverified and not used here.

## Open Questions

1. How does Zepto respond to the Diwali bonus criticism, and was the coupon-based payout a deliberate policy for delivery partners?
2. What were Zepto's Dhanteras and Diwali order volumes, and how is the gold and silver category performing compared with core grocery?
