# Zepto Pre-Meeting Briefing: Changes Over the Last 30 Days

**Meeting date:** 17 November 2026
**Briefing date:** 15 November 2026
**Review window:** 16 October to 15 November 2026
**Classification:** Objective synthesis of provided sources. Inferences are labelled as such.

## Executive Summary

Public sources provided for this window contain **no verified Zepto funding round, product launch, leadership appointment, or IPO filing dated between 16 October and 15 November 2026.** The most material developments are older but still shape the meeting agenda:

1. **Valuation reset (signal, not yet confirmed as a down round):** Multiples records a $4.5 billion valuation in an August 2026 round, down from $7 billion in October 2025 ([Multiples, 2026](https://multiples.vc/private-comps/zepto)).
2. **IPO timing is unconfirmed:** A May 2026 report said Zepto planned a ₹11,000-crore IPO in July ([Press Trust of India, 2026](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/zepto-plans-to-float-rs-11000-crore-ipo-in-july-126052100806_1.html)). No later source in the set confirms that the July timetable held.
3. **Hiring remains active:** A job aggregator lists 183 verified Zepto vacancies for November 2026, mostly field delivery roles ([Apna, 2026](https://apna.co/jobs/zepto-jobs)).
4. **Festive quick-commerce competition is intensifying:** Amazon and Flipkart are entering quick commerce, and festive quick-commerce GMV is projected to grow 110–120% year on year in 2026 ([BW Online Bureau, 2026](https://www.bwmarketingworld.com/article/quick-commerce-enters-bigger-basket-battle-as-blinkit-zepto-face-amazon-flipkart-627434)).

**Analyst assessment:** The most important item for the meeting is the apparent gap between Zepto's reported revenue growth and its falling valuation multiple. Zepto should be asked to clarify this directly before any IPO discussion.

## Company Profile and Baseline

Zepto was founded in 2021 by Aadit Palicha and Kaivalya Vohra ([Hirist, 2026](https://www.hirist.tech/zepto-careers)). It is a Bengaluru-based quick-commerce company offering over 45,000 products and competing with Blinkit and Swiggy's Instamart ([Reuters, 2025](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indias-quick-commerce-company-zepto-074521951.html)). Aadit Palicha has served as CEO since 2021 ([Unify, 2026](https://www.unifygtm.com/insights/executives/zepto-ceo)).

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### News and Corporate Events

No verified Zepto news item dated within the 16 October to 15 November 2026 window appears in the provided sources. The closest items are as follows.

| Item | Date | Status for this window | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Zepto "beyond groceries" feature article | 29 Sep 2026 | Just outside window; indicates non-grocery expansion | [Unify, 2026](https://www.unifygtm.com/insights/executives/zepto-ceo) |
| Quick commerce basket-expansion analysis | 8 Oct 2026 | Just outside window; market context | [BW Online Bureau, 2026](https://www.bwmarketingworld.com/article/quick-commerce-enters-bigger-basket-battle-as-blinkit-zepto-face-amazon-flipkart-627434) |
| Economic Times article tagged "Zepto ED case" | Last updated 9 Jun 2026 | Tag only; article body not available | [The Economic Times, 2026](https://m.economictimes.com/industry/services/retail/customers-will-feast-as-zepto-to-pour-fuel-into-quick-commerce-fire/articleshow/131605658.cms) |

The Economic Times page carries the tag "Zepto ED case" alongside "Zepto IPO date" and "Zepto orders" ([The Economic Times, 2026](https://m.economictimes.com/industry/services/retail/customers-will-feast-as-zepto-to-pour-fuel-into-quick-commerce-fire/articleshow/131605658.cms)). The body text supplied does not describe the enforcement matter, so its status cannot be verified. The meeting should raise it only as a question, not as an established fact.

### Product Launches

No product launch dated within the window is verified. The strategic direction is documented in market analysis. Quick commerce is moving beyond grocery into electronics, beauty, festive purchases, and non-metro markets ([BW Online Bureau, 2026](https://www.bwmarketingworld.com/article/quick-commerce-enters-bigger-basket-battle-as-blinkit-zepto-face-amazon-flipkart-627434)). Redseer's Kushal Bhatnagar notes that Amazon and Flipkart may have an advantage in electronics because of their brand relationships and assortment breadth ([BW Online Bureau, 2026](https://www.bwmarketingworld.com/article/quick-commerce-enters-bigger-basket-battle-as-blinkit-zepto-face-amazon-flipkart-627434)).

### Leadership Hires

- **No Zepto hire is verified within the window.** The LinkedIn "Top Hires" roundup for March 2026 contains no Zepto appointment ([Leadership Announcements, 2026](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/top-hires-from-march-2026-leadership-announcements-c7ihc)).
- **The most recent verified senior appointment is earlier.** On 19 June 2026, Zepto appointed Sushant S. as Director & India Head – People Experience, Workforce Governance, Enterprise Transformation & Operations Strategy. The role covers more than 300,000 personnel, including over 50,000 associates and 250,000 riders, and operational support across more than 1,000 stores and facilities ([Apparel Resources, 2026](https://apparelresources.com/business-news/retail/zepto-strengthens-leadership-sushant-s-appointment)).

### Deals and Financing

- **Most recent round:** A $105 million undisclosed-stage round in August 2026, led by or including General Catalyst, Glade Brook Capital Partners, Goodwater Capital, and Nexus Venture Partners ([Multiples, 2026](https://multiples.vc/private-comps/zepto)). This falls outside the 30-day window.
- **Tracxn lists no new round within the window.** Its latest-round entry is dated 16 October 2025, a $300 million Series H, even though its page was last updated on 11 November 2026 ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/companies/zepto/__vOTzafGt-8S4kwYniiZ_yRogd6c_Jsw_vRD0gckHtfE/funding-and-investors)).
- **IPO filing:** Zepto filed confidentially with SEBI in late December 2025 for an IPO worth ₹110 billion (about $1.22 billion) ([Reuters, 2025](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indias-quick-commerce-company-zepto-074521951.html)).
- **Planned listing:** Zepto was reported in May 2026 to plan a ₹11,000-crore IPO in July, with the listing placing it alongside Zomato and Swiggy ([Press Trust of India, 2026](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/zepto-plans-to-float-rs-11000-crore-ipo-in-july-126052100806_1.html)). The report cites people familiar with the matter, not an official announcement.

## Financial and Valuation Trajectory

Figures below are from Multiples, which notes that revenue values are typically run-rate or last-twelve-month figures recorded at the time of each deal ([Multiples, 2026](https://multiples.vc/private-comps/zepto)).

Reuters reported in December 2025 that Zepto was valued at $7 billion after raising $450 million in October 2025 ([Reuters, 2025](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indias-quick-commerce-company-zepto-074521951.html)). An Inc42 post attributes the same round to CalPERS and describes the valuation as up from $5 billion ([Inc42 Media, 2025](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/inc42_newsmakers-activity-7385629592016994304-qiGI)).

**Analyst assessment:**
- The reported August 2026 valuation of $4.5 billion is about 36% below the $7 billion mark of October 2025. If accurate, that is a down-round or structured-valuation outcome, though the source does not state the round's terms.
- Recorded revenue rose from $1.3 billion to $2.4 billion over the same period, roughly 85%. The compression of the revenue multiple from 5.6x to 1.9x therefore reflects both a higher revenue base and a lower price investors were willing to pay.
- Multiples reports total funding of $2.6 billion across 14 rounds ([Multiples, 2026](https://multiples.vc/private-comps/zepto)), while Tracxn reports $2.29 billion across 14 rounds ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/companies/zepto/__vOTzafGt-8S4kwYniiZ_yRogd6c_Jsw_vRD0gckHtfE/funding-and-investors)). The gap should be reconciled before any figure is used externally.

## Market Context

- The Indian quick-commerce market is projected to reach $70–90 billion by FY31 ([BW Online Bureau, 2026](https://www.bwmarketingworld.com/article/quick-commerce-enters-bigger-basket-battle-as-blinkit-zepto-face-amazon-flipkart-627434)).
- Quick commerce accounted for around 11% of festive e-commerce spending in 2025 and could reach nearly 18% in 2026. Festive quick-commerce GMV is projected to grow 110–120% year on year, versus 16–18% for the rest of e-commerce ([BW Online Bureau, 2026](https://www.bwmarketingworld.com/article/quick-commerce-enters-bigger-basket-battle-as-blinkit-zepto-face-amazon-flipkart-627434)).
- Amazon Now and Flipkart Minutes are entering the segment. Blinkit and Zepto hold hyperlocal fulfilment and dark-store expertise, while Amazon and Flipkart hold established customer bases and stronger non-grocery positions ([BW Online Bureau, 2026](https://www.bwmarketingworld.com/article/quick-commerce-enters-bigger-basket-battle-as-blinkit-zepto-face-amazon-flipkart-627434)).

## Workforce and Employer Signals

- Zepto's job board presence shows 183 verified vacancies for November 2026. Listed examples include Delivery Partner roles in Pune at ₹50,000–₹80,000, and Delivery Executive roles in New Delhi, Nagpur, and Coimbatore, with salary not disclosed ([Apna, 2026](https://apna.co/jobs/zepto-jobs)).
- Zepto's employer rating on Hirist is 3.6 from 3.1 thousand reviews. The Cluster Manager role scores 3.1, the lowest among the profiles listed, and Team Lead scores 3.7 ([Hirist, 2026](https://www.hirist.tech/zepto-careers)).
- A Built In summary, which it notes is not reviewed or approved by Zepto, describes strengths in strategic direction and fast execution alongside cultural intensity, inconsistent people management, and limited frontline support ([Built In, 2026](https://builtin.com/company/zepto/faq/leadership-management)).

**Analyst assessment:** High delivery-role hiring combined with the lowest rating in the Cluster Manager tier suggests that middle-management capacity may be under pressure as the network scales. This is an inference from limited review data, not an established finding.

## Source Reliability and Information Gaps

| Gap | Impact | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| No Zepto primary disclosures (newsroom, filings, press releases) in source set | Cannot verify company-stated figures | Request official materials at meeting |
| Economic Times article body unavailable | "Zepto ED case" and "Zepto IPO date" tags unverified | Ask Zepto directly |
| Conflicting funding totals ($2.6B vs $2.29B) | Investor-facing figures uncertain | Request cap table and funding history |
| Conflicting headcount signals (Built In lists 1,000 total employees and a Carlsbad HQ; Apparel Resources cites 300,000 personnel) | Workforce size unclear, likely different definitions | Request headcount by category |
| Tavily entity profile carries a disclaimer that information may be outdated | Used only for baseline industry classification | Not relied on for figures |
| IPO July target not confirmed after May 2026 | Timeline may have changed | Ask for current status |

The Built In summary is also a secondary, LLM-derived compilation and is weighted lower than the Hirist and Apparel Resources items ([Built In, 2026](https://builtin.com/company/zepto/faq/leadership-management)).

## Overall Assessment

**Analyst assessment:** Zepto's operating scale and market position appear strong. The provided figures show revenue growing to $2.4 billion and an active hiring pipeline. However, the financial signals are mixed. The reported valuation reset from $7 billion to $4.5 billion, if confirmed, would materially affect IPO pricing expectations. The lack of a confirmed IPO date after the July target suggests the listing may have slipped. The festive season and the entry of Amazon and Flipkart create near-term competitive pressure. The meeting should prioritise clarity on valuation and listing timing over general relationship discussion.

## Three Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **Valuation and IPO timing:** Does the August 2026 valuation of $4.5 billion reflect a down round or structured terms relative to the $7 billion October 2025 round? Has the July 2026 IPO window been revised, and what is the current status of the confidential filing?

2. **Festive and category competition:** Given the projected 110–120% growth in festive quick-commerce GMV and the entry of Amazon Now and Flipkart Minutes, what is Zepto's plan to win electronics and festive baskets, and what average order value and non-metro penetration targets underpin it?

3. **Workforce stability and regulatory exposure:** With 250,000 riders and 50,000 associates in the network, and cluster-manager ratings of 3.1 on Hirist, what retention and management investments are planned? Can Zepto confirm the status of the enforcement matter referenced in the Economic Times tags?

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Zepto
**Meeting date:** 17 November 2026
**Window covered:** 18 October to 17 November 2026. All facts below come from the search results provided.

## Summary
Zepto's recent coverage centres on festive-season demand, a viral criticism of its Diwali bonus for delivery partners, and a brand campaign. The results contain no confirmed funding, hiring, or deal news from the last 30 days.

## Last 30 Days

**News and public sentiment**
- A viral video shows a Zepto delivery partner receiving "cash-like coupons" instead of money as a Diwali bonus, which one commenter called "Peanuts in the name of a bonus." The story sparked wider debate about gig-worker welfare and corporate responsibility in India's startup economy. (https://www.news18.com/viral/zeptos-diwali-bonus-video-goes-viral-delivery-partner-gets-cash-like-coupons-instead-of-money-peanuts-in-the-name-of-a-bonus-ws-l-10418467.html), 9 Nov 2026
- A social media post cited in the same article, dated 7 Nov 2026, linked Zepto to a "valuation 7 billion" claim. This is an unverified social post, not a confirmed figure. (https://www.news18.com/viral/zeptos-diwali-bonus-video-goes-viral-delivery-partner-gets-cash-like-coupons-instead-of-money-peanuts-in-the-name-of-a-bonus-ws-l-10418467.html)

**Launches and campaigns**
- Zepto delivered over 14,000 gold and silver coins in one hour during Dhanteras 2026. Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, and Flipkart Minutes all reported strong festive order growth. (https://indiabusinesstrade.in/dhanteras-2026-zepto-delivers-over-14000-gold-and-silver-coins-in-one-hour.htm), 8 Nov 2026
- Zepto launched a brand activation tied to Seoul Street fandoms, with "Anime India" flagged as next. Zepto did not say which fandom comes next. Fans are set to gather in Hyderabad on 14 November. (https://www.animationxpress.com/latest-news/zepto-lands-in-seoul-street-anime-india-is-up-next-the-fans-got-there-years-ago), 21 Oct 2026. Chief brand officer Chandan Mendiratta is quoted in the piece.

**People and HR**
- Zepto moved its post-Diwali scheduled holiday from Tuesday to Monday, giving employees an extra day off. Chief HR officer Sneha Arora said the aim was a longer festive weekend. (https://m.economictimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/india-inc-lights-up-diwali-with-longer-weekends-flexible-work-and-extra-pay-for-festive-shifts/articleshow/135618893.cms), 8 Nov 2026
- No executive hires or departures were found in the results for this window.

**Deals and funding**
- No deals or funding announcements from the last 30 days were found. An undated company profile lists a venture round of $100M dated 1 July 2026 and a Series H of $450M dated 16 November 2025. Both fall outside the window and are included for reference only. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/YT08vmcifB58)

**Excluded:** Results about the "zeptoverse" in particle physics (CERN/LHCb) and an Inc42 IPO tracker that does not mention Zepto were not relevant.

## Open questions
1. **Delivery partner pay:** How does Zepto respond to the Diwali bonus criticism, and is it reviewing how it pays delivery partners, including the use of coupons instead of cash? (https://www.news18.com/viral/zeptos-diwali-bonus-video-goes-viral-delivery-partner-gets-cash-like-coupons-instead-of-money-peanuts-in-the-name-of-a-bonus-ws-l-10418467.html)
2. **Festive results:** What were Zepto's Diwali order volumes and category mix, especially high-value gold and silver purchases, and does it plan to keep growing that segment after the festival? (https://indiabusinesstrade.in/dhanteras-2026-zepto-delivers-over-14000-gold-and-silver-coins-in-one-hour.htm)
3. **Funding and valuation:** The only sources for current valuation are an unverified social post and a July 2026 funding entry in an undated profile. What is the current valuation, and is any new funding planned? (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/YT08vmcifB58)

# Zepto Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

*Prepared 15 November 2026. Covers the 30-day window from 16 October to 15 November 2026, with earlier context where needed for interpretation.*

## Executive Summary

Zepto's most material developments concern its capital markets position, not its operations. The company has a planned IPO, a reported August 2026 funding round, and a valuation that appears to have fallen from about $7 billion in October 2025 to $4.5 billion in August 2026 ([Multiples, 2026](https://multiples.vc/private-comps/zepto)). Operationally, Zepto is expanding into larger baskets and festive commerce while competing with Amazon and Flipkart. Field hiring is active, while employee-sentiment sources point to leadership churn.

The provided material contains few dated, Zepto-specific events inside the 30-day window. Most substantive facts come from May to August 2026 or from earlier periods. This briefing separates in-window events from background context and flags conflicting data.

## Company Snapshot

| Attribute | Detail | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Founded | 2021 by Aadit Palicha and Kaivalya Vohra | [Hirist, 2026](https://www.hirist.tech/zepto-careers) |
| Headquarters | Bengaluru, India | [Multiples, 2026](https://multiples.vc/private-comps/zepto) |
| CEO | Aadit Palicha (CEO since 2021) | [Unify, 2026](https://www.unifygtm.com/insights/executives/zepto-ceo) |
| Catalogue | Over 45,000 products | [Reuters, 2025](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indias-quick-commerce-company-zepto-074521951.html) |
| Latest recorded revenue | $2.4B (recorded with August 2026 round; 1.9x revenue multiple) | [Multiples, 2026](https://multiples.vc/private-comps/zepto) |
| Latest recorded valuation | $4.5B (August 2026) | [Multiples, 2026](https://multiples.vc/private-comps/zepto) |
| Competitors | Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, Amazon Now, Flipkart Minutes | [Reuters, 2025](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indias-quick-commerce-company-zepto-074521951.html); [BW Online Bureau, 2026](https://www.bwmarketingworld.com/article/quick-commerce-enters-bigger-basket-battle-as-blinkit-zepto-face-amazon-flipkart-627434) |

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### News and Market Context

- **Market size and direction.** Quick commerce is projected to reach $70–90 billion by FY31, and players are moving beyond grocery into electronics, beauty, festive purchases and non-metro markets ([BW Online Bureau, 2026](https://www.bwmarketingworld.com/article/quick-commerce-enters-bigger-basket-battle-as-blinkit-zepto-face-amazon-flipkart-627434)). This article is dated 8 October 2026, just before the window, but it frames the current competitive period.
- **Festive season.** Quick commerce accounted for about 11% of festive e-commerce spending in 2025 and could reach nearly 18% in 2026. Festive quick-commerce GMV is projected to grow 110–120% year on year, against 16–18% for the rest of e-commerce ([BW Online Bureau, 2026](https://www.bwmarketingworld.com/article/quick-commerce-enters-bigger-basket-battle-as-blinkit-zepto-face-amazon-flipkart-627434)).
- **Competitive pressure from incumbents.** Analysts at Redseer note that Amazon and Flipkart may have an advantage in electronics because of their brand relationships and ability to pair assortment with faster fulfilment. Blinkit and Zepto, by contrast, have built expertise in hyperlocal fulfilment, dark-store networks and rapid delivery ([BW Online Bureau, 2026](https://www.bwmarketingworld.com/article/quick-commerce-enters-bigger-basket-battle-as-blinkit-zepto-face-amazon-flipkart-627434)).
- **Sector consolidation.** Multiples reports that DoorDash's announced acquisition of Instacart (October 2026) will deepen DoorDash's presence in grocery and local commerce delivery ([Multiples, 2026](https://multiples.vc/private-comps/zepto)). This is an adjacent deal, not a Zepto transaction, but it indicates consolidation among delivery platforms.

### Deals and Funding

- **Reported funding round (August 2026).** Multiples records a $105 million round at undisclosed stage, with General Catalyst, Glade Brook Capital Partners, Goodwater Capital and Nexus Venture Partners named as investors and a $4.5 billion valuation ([Multiples, 2026](https://multiples.vc/private-comps/zepto)). This date falls outside the 30-day window. Primary confirmation was not present in the provided material.
- **IPO filing status.** Zepto filed confidentially with SEBI in late December 2025 for an IPO worth ₹11,000 crore (about $1.22 billion) ([Reuters, 2025](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indias-quick-commerce-company-zepto-074521951.html)). In May 2026, people familiar with the matter said the IPO would launch in July ([Press Trust of India, 2026](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/zepto-plans-to-float-rs-11000-crore-ipo-in-july-126052100806_1.html)).
- **Updated DRHP (June 2026).** According to Dhan, the updated DRHP combines a fresh issue of ₹8,010 crore with an offer for sale, for a total size of about ₹10,000 crore. Axis Capital, Morgan Stanley India, Goldman Sachs (India), Motilal Oswal, HSBC Securities, JM Financial and IIFL Capital are the book-running lead managers ([Dhan, 2026](https://dhan.co/blog/ipo/zepto-funding-history-and-valuation-journey)).
- **Proceeds use.** The fresh issue proceeds are earmarked for dark-store expansion, technology and infrastructure, brand building, customer acquisition and general corporate purposes ([Dhan, 2026](https://dhan.co/blog/ipo/zepto-funding-history-and-valuation-journey)).

No IPO listing or launch within the window appears in the provided sources. The July target has passed, and this briefing cannot confirm whether the IPO has launched, been delayed or been withdrawn.

### Product and Market Expansion

- **Category expansion.** Zepto is one of the platforms moving into bigger baskets, including electronics, beauty and festive purchases ([BW Online Bureau, 2026](https://www.bwmarketingworld.com/article/quick-commerce-enters-bigger-basket-battle-as-blinkit-zepto-face-amazon-flipkart-627434)). The provided sources do not identify a specific product launch dated within the window.
- **Positioning.** An Economic Times article from June 2026 is titled "Customers will feast as Zepto to pour fuel into quick commerce fire," suggesting an expansion or investment push. Its body text was not available, so its details are unverified ([The Economic Times, 2026](https://m.economictimes.com/industry/services/retail/customers-will-feast-as-zepto-to-pour-fuel-into-quick-commerce-fire/articleshow/131605658.cms)).

### Hiring and Leadership

- **Field hiring.** A job aggregator lists 183 verified Zepto vacancies for November 2026, mostly field and delivery roles. One listing in Pune offers "urgently hiring" delivery partner roles at ₹50,000–80,000 per month. Delivery executive listings in New Delhi, Nagpur and Coimbatore do not disclose salary ([Apna, 2026](https://apna.co/jobs/zepto-jobs)).
- **Employee sentiment.** Hirist reports an overall Zepto rating of 3.6 from about 3,100 reviews. Ratings by role range from 3.1 for Cluster Manager to 3.9 for Shift Incharge ([Hirist, 2026](https://www.hirist.tech/zepto-careers)).
- **Leadership churn.** Built In reports that leadership used the phrase "conscious directional changes" to explain several senior exits after the $450 million raise at a $7 billion valuation. Built In's page is LLM-generated and not reviewed by Zepto, and it was last updated in April 2026 ([Built In, 2026](https://builtin.com/company/zepto/faq/leadership-management)).
- **Founder leadership.** Aadit Palicha has served as CEO since 2021 and remains in the seat as of the latest profile update ([Unify, 2026](https://www.unifygtm.com/insights/executives/zepto-ceo)).

### Regulatory Signals (Unverified)

Economic Times article tags include "Zepto ED news" and "Zepto ED case" ([The Economic Times, 2026](https://m.economictimes.com/industry/services/retail/customers-will-feast-as-zepto-to-pour-fuel-into-quick-commerce-fire/articleshow/131605658.cms)). The article body was unavailable, so the nature, status and date of any enforcement matter cannot be verified. This should be clarified before the meeting.

## Funding and Valuation Trajectory

| Date | Event | Valuation | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Oct 2025 | Series H, $300M (approximately $450M per Reuters) | $7B | [Multiples, 2026](https://multiples.vc/private-comps/zepto); [Reuters, 2025](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indias-quick-commerce-company-zepto-074521951.html) |
| Dec 2025 | Confidential IPO filing (₹11,000 crore) | Not stated | [Reuters, 2025](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indias-quick-commerce-company-zepto-074521951.html) |
| May 2026 | Reported July IPO plan | Not stated | [Press Trust of India, 2026](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/zepto-plans-to-float-rs-11000-crore-ipo-in-july-126052100806_1.html) |
| Jun 2026 | Updated DRHP (~₹10,000 crore total) | Not stated | [Dhan, 2026](https://dhan.co/blog/ipo/zepto-funding-history-and-valuation-journey) |
| Aug 2026 | $105M round | $4.5B | [Multiples, 2026](https://multiples.vc/private-comps/zepto) |

The implied change from $7 billion to $4.5 billion is a decline of roughly 36%, although the data sources differ on several figures (see Data Quality Notes).

## Assessment

**1. The valuation reset is the most significant development and needs direct clarification.** If the August 2026 mark of $4.5 billion is accurate, it represents a substantial markdown from the $7 billion level reported in October 2025. Revenue of $2.4 billion at a 1.9x multiple is consistent with a company priced more conservatively than its 2025 peers. This could be a secondary-market or structural effect, but it changes IPO pricing expectations. The IPO target of ₹10,000–11,000 crore should be tested against the current valuation.

**2. IPO timing is the main execution risk.** A July launch was reported in May, but no listing or launch appears in the provided sources by mid-November. Either the timeline has slipped, or the sources do not capture the update. Either way, the company's public-market narrative and its private-market mark are not yet fully aligned.

**3. Competitive position is strong operationally but exposed in large categories.** Zepto's hyperlocal network is a clear strength. However, Amazon and Flipkart have advantages in electronics and in brand relationships. Zepto's festive and bigger-basket push is therefore a credibility test rather than an assured gain. Festive quick commerce growth projections of 110–120% suggest that the category will be heavily contested.

**4. Talent signals are mixed.** High field-hiring volume supports the view that operations are scaling. Employee ratings near 3.1–3.7 and reports of senior churn indicate that retention of managers, particularly in cluster and store roles, may be a constraint on execution.

## Data Quality Notes

- **Funding totals conflict.** Multiples reports $2.6 billion across 14 rounds, Tracxn reports $2.29 billion across 14 rounds, and Dhan cites "over $2.4 billion" through October 2025 ([Multiples, 2026](https://multiples.vc/private-comps/zepto); [Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/companies/zepto/__vOTzafGt-8S4kwYniiZ_yRogd6c_Jsw_vRD0gckHtfE/funding-and-investors); [Dhan, 2026](https://dhan.co/blog/ipo/zepto-funding-history-and-valuation-journey)).
- **Valuation conflicts.** Tracxn reports a valuation of ₹61,100 crore as of November 2025, which is broadly consistent with $7 billion. Multiples' August 2026 figure of $4.5 billion has not been independently confirmed ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/companies/zepto/__vOTzafGt-8S4kwYniiZ_yRogd6c_Jsw_vRD0gckHtfE/funding-and-investors)).
- **IPO size.** Figures range from ₹10,000 crore (updated DRHP) to ₹11,000 crore (May 2026 report) ([Dhan, 2026](https://dhan.co/blog/ipo/zepto-funding-history-and-valuation-journey); [Press Trust of India, 2026](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/zepto-plans-to-float-rs-11000-crore-ipo-in-july-126052100806_1.html)).
- **Headquarters.** Built In lists Carlsbad, which conflicts with Bengaluru in other sources. Built In's data is also LLM-generated ([Built In, 2026](https://builtin.com/company/zepto/faq/leadership-management)).
- **Entity disambiguation.** A Zepto Australia page describes a real-time payments business and a Chief Business Resilience Officer appointment effective 23 February 2026. This refers to a different company and has been excluded from this briefing ([Zepto, 2026](https://zepto.com.au/insights/zepto-appoints-mariana-paun-as-chief-business-resilience-officer)). Meeting materials should avoid conflating the two entities.
- **Source age.** Several key sources date from May to August 2026. Figures should be re-verified against the latest SEBI filings and company disclosures before the meeting.

## Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **IPO and valuation:** What is the current status of the IPO, including the DRHP timing, the fresh-issue and offer-for-sale mix, and the target size? How does the August 2026 valuation of about $4.5 billion influence pricing expectations relative to the October 2025 round at about $7 billion?

2. **Festive performance and competitive positioning:** What were Zepto's festive-season 2026 GMV, order volumes and non-grocery share? How is the company responding to Amazon Now and Flipkart Minutes in electronics and other bigger-basket categories?

3. **Leadership, workforce and regulatory matters:** What steps are being taken to retain senior managers after reported exits, and how are delivery-partner pay and retention being managed given the current hiring push? Can the company clarify the matter referenced in the Economic Times tags as "Zepto ED case," including its status and any implications for operations or the IPO?

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Canva, 17 November 2026

**Window:** Roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026. Search results cover early November only.

## Restructuring and workforce

- Canva is cutting about 22% of its staff, 1,271 people, as it flattens its org chart and consolidates teams (https://www.computerworld.com/article/3816579/tech-layoffs-this-year-a-timeline.html; https://m.economictimes.com/news/international/world-news/canva-layoffs-2026-meet-ceo-melanie-perkins-who-plans-to-give-away-80-of-her-billion-dollar-fortune-as-1271-jobs-are-cut/articleshow/135575689.cms). One outlet reported "just over 1,200" (https://tech.yahoo.com/general/breaking-news/article/tech-layoffs-tracker-2026-all-the-job-losses-across-canva-squarespace-amazon-microsoft-apple-meta-and-others-141507340.html).
- The company is merging its product, growth and platform teams and reducing "subspecialisation," so remaining staff may take on broader roles (https://tech.yahoo.com/general/breaking-news/article/tech-layoffs-tracker-2026-all-the-job-losses-across-canva-squarespace-amazon-microsoft-apple-meta-and-others-141507340.html).
- CEO Melanie Perkins said "small changes won't be enough" and that Canva needs to "re-found" itself around small, empowered teams (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304).
- Departing staff receive at least six months' salary, keep their company MacBooks, get a free year of LinkedIn Premium, and can apply for $US10,000 grants to start a business or community project (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304; https://m.economictimes.com/news/international/world-news/canva-layoffs-2026-meet-ceo-melanie-perkins-who-plans-to-give-away-80-of-her-billion-dollar-fortune-as-1271-jobs-are-cut/articleshow/135575689.cms).
- Capital Brief reported that Canva could make another round of redundancies or impose a hiring freeze in November. Canva has not confirmed either (https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137).
- Capital Brief also reported unreported finance-division cuts in January, with 32 roles made redundant (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).
- The same report cites a "revised revenue growth outlook" as context for the AI push, with no figures given (https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137).

## Launches and AI

- Canva launched its second in-house AI model, then expanded its OpenAI partnership, giving it broader access to OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra and GPT-5.6 models. The two companies will work on making them cheaper to run. No savings or costs were disclosed. OpenAI already powers Canva Code (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).

## Marketing

- Canva unveiled a North America campaign, "What Will You Canva Today?", created by agency GS&P. The first TV spot aired on NBC Sunday Night Football on 1 November (https://www.mediapost.com/publications/article/419113/canva-unveils-campaign-by-new-agency-gsp.html).

## Hires and deals

- **Hires:** No relevant hiring announcements were found in the results.
- **Deals:** The only deal in the window is the OpenAI expansion above. The company profile lists acquisitions dated March and April 2026 (Ortto, SimTheory, Doohly at US$30M), which fall outside the 30-day window. They are background only (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/wafeqPWRLzYp).

**Source note:** Sources differ on headcount (1,271 vs. "just over 1,200") and on the ABC article's date (metadata says 3 November; URL says 4 November).

## Open questions

1. Will Canva proceed with a November redundancy round or hiring freeze, and which teams would be affected? Does that change our account coverage?
2. With product, growth and platform teams merging, who will own our account and decisions after the restructure, and what is the new escalation path?
3. What cost savings and pricing effects does the expanded OpenAI deal and in-house model strategy have for partners and integrations, and is any of this changing roadmap timing?
